name: app.R
content:
# Melbourne in N Hours
# GEOM90007 Assignment 3, Group 24. Client: City of Melbourne. Users: short-stay visitors who only have
# a few free hours here and there (between conference sessions, before a train or a flight).
#
# Flow: the home page decides where to go and on which half day: one row per day, split into morning,
# afternoon and evening, on the left; the ready-made walks (mostly the City's own self-guided walks)
# and every place on the right, to drag into a part of a day or add with + (R/overview.R, R/slots.R),
# each with how long it takes and how tiring it is. Its gear buttons open the free-time settings
# (calendar file, examples, adding, changing, exporting) -> one free time at a time: the order, the
# times and the route on a map, place details.
#
# Run from this folder:  shiny::runApp()
# Packages: shiny, shinyjs, leaflet, htmltools, jsonlite (all data is pre-processed by the scripts in tools/).

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

# GEOM90007 Week 8 (page 8.5) library for embedding Tableau Public vizzes; loads shinyjs.
source("tableau-in-shiny-v1.2.R")
source("R/data.R")
source("R/i18n.R")      # English / Chinese (Trip settings)
source("R/planner.R")
source("R/effort.R")
source("R/views.R")
source("R/calendar.R")
source("R/overview.R")
source("R/bundles.R")
source("R/slots.R")
source("R/timeline.R")
source("R/export.R")    # the plan as a document to print or save as a PDF
source("R/eat_stay.R")  # "Where to eat" and "Where to stay" in the Overview menu

D <- load_app_data("data")
B <- load_bundles(D, "data/bundles.csv")   # walks suggested on the home page
E <- load_eat_stay(D, "data")              # places to eat and to stay (2024 census)
DEST <- load_destinations("data")          # must-try restaurants (Where to eat; NULL until built)
CITY_BUSY <- city_busy_levels(D)           # street band on each day of the home page
addResourcePath("appdata", "data")   # the 3D map loads data/buildings_3d.geojson from here
TIME_CHOICES <- fmt_time(seq(6 * 60, 23 * 60 + 45, by = 15))
START_CHOICES <- list(`Stations & venues` = setNames(D$starts$id, D$starts$name),
                      `Places` = setNames(D$places$id, D$places$name))
HOME_CHOICES <- setNames(D$starts$id, D$starts$name)
# The English / Chinese switch in Trip settings (R/i18n.R). On in this (local) version; set the
# environment variable to "0" for an English-only build (the pushed demo so far).
SHOW_LANGUAGE <- Sys.getenv("NHOURS_LANGUAGE_SWITCH", "1") == "1"

node_name <- function(id) {      # in the current language (R/i18n.R)
  if (id %in% D$places$id) place_name(D, match(id, D$places$id)) else start_name(D, id)
}
# Start / end point choices in the current language.
start_choices <- function() setNames(list(setNames(D$starts$id, start_name(D, D$starts$id)),
                                          setNames(D$places$id, place_name(D, seq_len(nrow(D$places))))),
                                     tr(c("Stations & venues", "Places")))
# auto = TRUE: start and end are "where you stay" and follow the nights chosen on Where to stay
# (start_auto / end_auto, as for the home base in R/calendar.R free_windows).
manual_window <- function(id, date, t0, t1, start, end, auto = FALSE) {
  data.frame(id = id, date = as.Date(date), t0 = t0, t1 = t1, start = start, end = end, source = "manual",
             base_t0 = t0, base_start = start, rest = 0, start_auto = auto, end_auto = auto)
}

# Three example visitors (the personas in the report). The conference calendar is made up for the demo.
EXAMPLES <- list(
  conference = list(title = "Conference visitor", sub = "Calendar file · free gaps Wed to Sat",
                    ics = "data/example_calendar_conference.ics", from = "2026-11-04", to = "2026-11-07",
                    home = "flinders_st_stn", indoor = FALSE, free = FALSE,
                    wish = c("ngv_intl", "state_library", "qvm", "hosier_lane", "parliament", "old_gaol",
                             "botanic", "skydeck")),
  daytrip    = list(title = "Day trip by V/Line", sub = "Sat · Southern Cross · 10:00 to 17:30",
                    windows = manual_window("w1", "2026-11-14", 600, 1050, "southern_cross", "southern_cross"),
                    indoor = FALSE, free = TRUE,
                    wish = c("qvm", "state_library", "hosier_lane", "chinatown", "botanic")),
  layover    = list(title = "Rainy layover", sub = "Tue · Southern Cross · 11:00 to 15:00",
                    windows = manual_window("w1", "2026-11-10", 660, 900, "southern_cross", "southern_cross"),
                    indoor = TRUE, free = FALSE,
                    wish = c("state_library", "block_arcade", "immigration"))
)

today_mel <- as.Date(format(Sys.time(), tz = "Australia/Melbourne"))

# An example turned into free times and a plan (same steps as for a visitor's own calendar).
load_example <- function(k) {
  ex <- EXAMPLES[[k]]
  ws <- if (!is.null(ex$ics)) free_windows(parse_ics(ex$ics), seq(as.Date(ex$from), as.Date(ex$to), by = 1), D, home = ex$home)
        else ex$windows
  f <- auto_fill(D, B, ws, ex$wish)
  list(windows = ws, slots = f$slots, walks = f$walks)
}
# What a first-time visitor (and a marker without a calendar file) sees: the conference visitor's
# example calendar, already planned, on the overview page.
START_EXAMPLE <- "conference"
START <- load_example(START_EXAMPLE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- UI

EXAMPLE_ICONS <- c(conference = "🎫", daytrip = "🚆", layover = "☂️")
# files in www/ carry their change time, so the browser never keeps an old copy
asset <- function(f) sprintf("%s?v=%d", f, as.integer(file.mtime(file.path("www", f))))

# Trip settings: a sheet that slides in over the page (the "Trip settings" button in the top bar opens it,
# www/app.js). It is a sheet, not a page of its own, so the days and plans behind it can be seen
# changing; there are no accounts, so nothing else needs a settings page. Here: the language, how often
# you exercise, reading a calendar file, the examples and exporting. The free times themselves are
# changed on the overview (drag a day's bar, + Add a day, × to remove) and on the day pages.
free_sheet <- tagList(
  div(class = "sheet-backdrop", onclick = "closeFreeTimes()"),
  tags$aside(id = "free_sheet", class = "sheet", role = "dialog", `aria-label` = "Free time settings",
    div(class = "sheet-head",
      div(class = "card-icon", ICON$gear),
      div(h2(i18n("Trip settings")), p(i18n("Your calendar, how often you exercise, the examples and export. The days and plans behind update at once."))),
      tags$button(class = "sheet-close", title = "Close", onclick = "closeFreeTimes()", "×")),
    div(class = "sheet-body",
      # the language of the whole interface (R/i18n.R; the choice is remembered in this browser, www/app.js)
      if (SHOW_LANGUAGE) tags$section(id = "ft-lang", class = "setup-card lang-card",
        div(class = "sheet-card-head", div(class = "card-icon", "Aa"), h3(i18n("Language"))),
        div(class = "lang-switch", role = "group",
          tags$button(`data-lang` = "en", class = "active", onclick = "setLang('en')", "English"),
          tags$button(`data-lang` = "zh", onclick = "setLang('zh')", HTML("中文")))),
      # how tiring walking feels depends on the visitor (R/effort.R FITNESS)
      tags$section(id = "ft-fitness", class = "setup-card fitness-card",
        div(class = "sheet-card-head", div(class = "card-icon", "🏃"),
            div(h3(i18n("How often do you exercise?")),
                p(i18n("So that “easy” and “tiring” on your days fit you.")))),
        radioButtons("fitness", NULL, inline = TRUE, selected = "sometimes",
                     choiceNames = list(i18n("Often"), i18n("Sometimes"), i18n("Hardly ever")),
                     choiceValues = c("often", "sometimes", "hardly"))),
      tags$section(id = "ft-import", class = "setup-card featured",
        div(class = "sheet-card-head", div(class = "card-icon", ICON$calendar),
            div(h3(i18n("From your calendar")), p(i18n("We find the gaps of 90 minutes or more between your events. The file is read on this computer only.")))),
        div(class = "dropzone",
          ICON$upload,
          strong(i18n("Drop your calendar here")),
          span(i18n(".ics from Apple, Google or Outlook")),
          fileInput("ics", NULL, accept = c(".ics", "text/calendar"), buttonLabel = i18n("Choose file"), placeholder = "No file yet")),
        dateRangeInput("trip_dates", i18n("Days in Melbourne"),
                       start = as.Date(EXAMPLES$conference$from), end = as.Date(EXAMPLES$conference$to)),
        div(class = "two-fields",
          selectInput("day_from", i18n("Out from"), TIME_CHOICES, "08:00"),
          selectInput("day_to", i18n("Back by"), TIME_CHOICES, "21:00")),
        selectInput("home", i18n("Staying near"), HOME_CHOICES, "flinders_st_stn"),
        tags$button(id = "find_free", class = "btn primary action-button", i18n("Find my free time"), ICON$arrow),
        p(class = "hint", i18n("This replaces the free times above."))),
      tags$section(id = "ft-examples", class = "setup-card examples",
        div(class = "sheet-card-head", div(class = "card-icon yellow", "✦"), h3(i18n("Try an example"))),
        lapply(names(EXAMPLES), function(k) tags$button(
          class = "persona", onclick = js_input("example", k),
          span(class = "persona-icon", EXAMPLE_ICONS[[k]]),
          span(strong(i18n(EXAMPLES[[k]]$title)), tags$small(i18n(EXAMPLES[[k]]$sub))),
          tags$b("›")))),
      tags$section(id = "ft-export", class = "setup-card",
        div(class = "sheet-card-head", div(class = "card-icon blue", ICON$download),
            div(h3(i18n("Export")), p(i18n("Your plan as a document to print or save as a PDF, or as calendar files (.ics) that Apple, Google and Outlook can open.")))),
        div(class = "export-links",
          tags$button(class = "btn primary", onclick = "closeFreeTimes(); openExport('all')", ICON$download, i18n("Plan (PDF)")),
          downloadLink("plan_ics", tagList(ICON$download, i18n("My plan")), class = "btn secondary"),
          downloadLink("example_ics", tagList(ICON$download, i18n("The example calendar")), class = "btn secondary")),
        p(class = "hint", i18n("My plan: one event per stop, at the times of the shortest-walk order."))))))

# Export: the plan as a document (R/export.R) over the whole window, with its own bar: back, which
# free times, the calendar file, and "Save as PDF" (the browser's print window; only the document is
# printed, www/app.js and the print rules in www/style.css).
export_view <- div(id = "export_view", class = "export-view", role = "dialog", `aria-label` = "Export your plan",
  div(class = "export-bar",
    tags$button(class = "btn secondary", onclick = "closeExport()", "‹", i18n("Back to planning")),
    div(class = "export-title", strong(i18n("Export your plan")),
        span(i18n("Save it as a PDF: every place, map and “Directions” link stays clickable."))),
    uiOutput("export_scope_ui", inline = TRUE),
    downloadLink("plan_ics_export", tagList(ICON$calendar, i18n("Calendar (.ics)")), class = "btn secondary"),
    div(class = "export-save",
      tags$button(class = "btn primary", onclick = "printExport()", ICON$download, i18n("Save as PDF")),
      tags$small(i18n("In the print window, choose “Save as PDF”.")))),
  div(class = "export-scroll", uiOutput("export_doc")))

# A time as an hour list and a minute list (quarter hours), for the hidden input `id` (www/app.js syncHM).
time_picker <- function(id) {
  span(class = "hm", `data-for` = id,
    tags$select(class = "hh", `aria-label` = "Hour", lapply(6:23, function(h) tags$option(value = sprintf("%02d", h), sprintf("%02d", h)))),
    tags$b(":"),
    tags$select(class = "mm", `aria-label` = "Minutes", lapply(c("00", "15", "30", "45"), function(m) tags$option(value = m, m))))
}

# One free time: three columns — places on the left, the map in its own card in the middle, the
# plan on the right — so the panels never cover the map. A place can be dragged from the list into
# the plan (it is added and the order worked out again), and a stop from the plan back onto the list
# (taken out); www/app.js. The hint at the top of each column shows while something is dragged.
day_view <- div(class = "planner",
  tags$aside(class = "place-panel", `data-drop` = "pool",
    div(class = "drop-hint out", tags$b("×"), span(i18n("Drop here to take it out of this day"))),
    div(class = "filters",
      h3(i18n("Places")),
      checkboxInput("indoor", i18n("Indoor only"), FALSE),
      checkboxInput("free", i18n("Free entry only"), FALSE)),
    uiOutput("picker")),
  div(class = "map-area",
    leafletOutput("map", height = "100%"),
    div(id = "map3d", class = "map3d"),                       # 3D view, drawn by www/map3d.js
    div(class = "map-controls",
      tags$button(class = "active", `data-mode` = "2d", onclick = "Shiny.setInputValue('map_mode', '2d')", "2D"),
      tags$button(`data-mode` = "3d", onclick = "Shiny.setInputValue('map_mode', '3d')", "3D")),
    div(class = "map-legend",
      lapply(1:3, function(l) span(tags$i(style = sprintf("background:%s", BUSY_COLS[l])), i18n(BUSY_LABELS[l]),
                                   tags$small(BUSY_RANGES[l]))),
      span(class = "legend-unit", i18n("people per hour")),
      span(title = "Places with a ring could still be added to this free time", tags$i(class = "ring"), i18n("Can still be added")))),
  tags$aside(class = "plan-panel", `data-slot` = "day",
    div(class = "drop-hint in", tags$b("+"), span(class = "drop-note", i18n("Drop to add it to this day"))),
    # The free time's hours are changed here, at the top (or by dragging the day's bar on the overview).
    div(class = "plan-date",
      div(uiOutput("win_day"),
          div(class = "plan-times", title = "Change when you set off and when you need to be back",
            time_picker("t0"), span("–"), time_picker("back"),
            div(class = "plan-times-inputs",           # the inputs the server reads and sets (www/app.js syncHM)
              selectInput("t0", NULL, TIME_CHOICES, "13:00", selectize = FALSE),
              selectInput("back", NULL, TIME_CHOICES, "18:00", selectize = FALSE)))),
      uiOutput("win_free", inline = TRUE)),
    uiOutput("rest_ui"),
    div(class = "plan-fields",
      selectInput("start", i18n("From", "From (place)"), START_CHOICES),
      selectInput("end", i18n("Back at"), START_CHOICES),
      # somewhere not in the lists: an address or a hotel, from the same search as Where to stay
      div(class = "own-point",
        tags$button(type = "button", class = "link-btn", onclick = "toggleOwnPoint()", i18n("+ Start or end somewhere else")),
        div(class = "own-point-body",
          div(class = "own-point-which", role = "group",
            tags$button(type = "button", class = "on", `data-which` = "pt_start", onclick = "ownPointWhich(this)", i18n("From", "From (place)")),
            tags$button(type = "button", `data-which` = "pt_end", onclick = "ownPointWhich(this)", i18n("Back at"))),
          stay_search_box("pt_start", "Address or hotel, e.g. 45 William St"))),
      selectInput("pace", i18n("Pace"), c(Relaxed = "relaxed", Normal = "normal", Brisk = "brisk"), "normal")),
    uiOutput("status"),
    uiOutput("options"),
    uiOutput("itinerary"),
    uiOutput("fits"),
    div(class = "credits",
      i18n("City of Melbourne Open Data · Vicmap Transport (DataVic) · official websites · © OpenStreetMap contributors"))))

# Overview page: the three columns (rendered on the server) and the data sources under them.
overview_view <- tagList(
  uiOutput("overview"),
  div(class = "page page-follow",
    p(class = "page-credit",
      i18n("Data: City of Melbourne Open Data (pedestrian counts, landmarks, toilets, drinking fountains); Vicmap Transport (DataVic) for walking routes; opening hours from each place's official website. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors."))))

# Where to eat / Where to stay (the Overview menu in the top bar; R/eat_stay.R): the filters are part
# of the page, the lists and maps follow the plan.
eat_view <- div(class = "page es-page",
  div(class = "page-title",
    h1(i18n("Where to eat")),
    p(i18n("You eat on the way: for each meal we look around the middle of the walks your plan has at that time. Set when you want to eat; click a meal to see it on the map, or a name for reviews and opening hours on Google Maps."))),
  div(class = "es-filters",
    checkboxGroupInput("eat_kind", NULL, inline = TRUE, selected = names(EAT_KINDS),
                       choiceNames = unname(lapply(EAT_KINDS, i18n)), choiceValues = names(EAT_KINDS)),
    checkboxInput("eat_outdoor", i18n("Outdoor seats"), FALSE),
    checkboxInput("eat_group", i18n("Room for a group (40+ seats)"), FALSE),
    div(class = "fold-all",
        tags$button(type = "button", onclick = "foldAll('eat', true)", i18n("Fold all days")),
        tags$button(type = "button", onclick = "foldAll('eat', false)", i18n("Unfold all")))),
  div(class = "es-cols",
    div(class = "es-list",
      uiOutput("eat_list"),
      if (!is.null(DEST)) tags$section(class = "must-eat",
        div(class = "must-head",
          div(h3(i18n("Worth a trip for the food")),
              p(i18n("If you really want to eat at one place, go there on purpose: save it and every day's page lists it with the places (when it is open), or add it to a day. The list starts with restaurants that food guides rate highly; search for any other by name."))),
          tags$input(type = "search", class = "must-q", placeholder = "Search: name, cuisine or dish",
                     oninput = "mustSearch(this)", `aria-label` = "Search the restaurants")),
        uiOutput("must_list"),
        uiOutput("food_more"))),
    div(class = "es-map", leafletOutput("eat_map", height = "100%"))),
  p(class = "page-credit",
    i18n("Places to eat: City of Melbourne Open Data, Café, restaurant, bistro seats (Census of Land Use and Employment 2024, CC BY), which has names, addresses and seats only. Walking times are estimates: straight-line distance times the detour of our walking network. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors.")))

# Where to stay: the title, the nights (one search box per night for hotels and addresses) and the
# map, where every hotel is coloured by how close it is and can be picked from its popup.
stay_view <- div(class = "page es-page",
  div(class = "page-title", h1(i18n("Where to stay"))),
  div(class = "es-cols",
    div(class = "es-list", uiOutput("stay_nights_ui")),
    div(class = "es-map", leafletOutput("stay_map", height = "100%"))),
  p(class = "page-credit",
    i18n("Places to stay: City of Melbourne Open Data, Business establishments location and industry classification (Census of Land Use and Employment 2024, Accommodation, CC BY); student housing, university colleges and boarding houses are left out. Typed addresses: City of Melbourne Open Data, Street addresses (CC BY). Walking times are estimates: straight-line distance times the detour of our walking network. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors.")))

ui <- fluidPage(
  title = "Melbourne in N Hours",
  tags$head(
    tags$meta(name = "viewport", content = "width=device-width, initial-scale=1"),
    tags$link(rel = "preconnect", href = "https://fonts.googleapis.com"),
    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Nunito:wght@700;800&display=swap"),
    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "vendor/maplibre-gl/maplibre-gl.css"),
    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = asset("style.css")),
    tags$script(src = "vendor/maplibre-gl/maplibre-gl.js"),
    tags$script(src = asset("app.js")),
    tags$script(src = asset("map3d.js"))
  ),
  useShinyjs(),   # switching views, the sheets and runjs() all need it
  div(class = "app",
    tags$header(class = "topbar",
      tags$button(class = "brand", onclick = js_input("goto", "overview"), span("N"), strong("Melbourne in N Hours")),
      uiOutput("trip_tabs", class = "trip-tabs"),
      tags$button(class = "nav-settings nav-export", onclick = "openExport()", title = "Your plan as a PDF or a calendar file",
                  ICON$download, i18n("Export")),
      tags$button(class = "nav-settings", onclick = "openFreeTimes()", title = "Calendar, exercise, examples, export",
                  ICON$gear, i18n("Trip settings"))),
    div(class = "views",
      div(id = "view_overview", class = "view", overview_view),
      shinyjs::hidden(div(id = "view_eat", class = "view", eat_view)),
      shinyjs::hidden(div(id = "view_stay", class = "view", stay_view)),
      shinyjs::hidden(div(id = "view_day", class = "view view-day", day_view)))),
  free_sheet,
  export_view
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- server

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # This visitor's own copy of the data. The places they sleep (Where to stay) are added to it as
  # extra start / end points (R/eat_stay.R add_stay_node), so every plan, sum and map in this session
  # (day_plans, day_sums, window_ctx, the day page) uses this D, and other visitors never see them.
  D <- D; E <- E
  node_name <- function(id) if (id %in% D$places$id) place_name(D, match(id, D$places$id)) else start_name(D, id)
  start_choices <- function() {    # start / end point choices: where you stay, stations & venues, places
    mine <- startsWith(D$starts$id, "stay_"); own <- startsWith(D$starts$id, "pt_")
    sights <- D$places$category %in% CATEGORY_ORDER
    named <- function(ids) if (length(ids)) setNames(ids, start_name(D, ids)) else character()
    g <- list(named(D$starts$id[mine]), named(D$starts$id[own]), named(D$starts$id[!mine & !own]),
              setNames(D$places$id[sights], place_name(D, which(sights))))
    g <- setNames(g, tr(c("Where you stay", "Added by you", "Stations & venues", "Places")))
    g[lengths(g) > 0]
  }
  refresh_point_choices <- function() {
    ch <- start_choices()
    for (id in c("start", "end")) updateSelectInput(session, id, choices = ch, selected = isolate(input[[id]]))
  }
  windows <- reactiveVal(START$windows)     # free times of the trip
  slots <- reactiveVal(START$slots)         # "<window id>|<part or any>" -> place ids (R/slots.R)
  slot_walks <- reactiveVal(START$walks)    # "<window id>|<part>" -> id of the walk the part was filled with
  view <- reactiveVal("overview")           # a page of the Overview menu (NAV_PAGES) or a window id
  example_on <- reactiveVal(START_EXAMPLE)  # which example is loaded (NA once the visitor uses their own)
  focus <- reactiveVal(NA_character_)       # place shown in the popup on the day map
  chosen_key <- reactiveVal("shortest")
  fit_request <- reactiveVal(0)
  pending <- reactiveVal(NULL)              # input values being pushed to the day bar

  `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
  pace <- reactive(input$pace %||% "normal")
  # window id -> place ids planned in it (its parts in time order, then the day-page additions)
  day_sel <- reactive({
    ws <- windows(); sl <- slots()
    setNames(lapply(ws$id, function(id) window_places(sl, id)), ws$id)
  })
  set_slots <- function(r) { slots(r$slots); slot_walks(r$walks) }

  # ---- switching views ----
  active_w <- reactive({
    w <- windows(); v <- view()
    if (v %in% w$id) w[w$id == v, ] else NULL
  })
  # Put a free time's values into the day panel's inputs. Until they all arrive, the input observer
  # below ignores the changes (so half-updated inputs never overwrite the free time).
  push_inputs <- function(w) {
    target <- list(start = w$start, t0 = fmt_time(w$t0), back = fmt_time(w$t1), end = w$end)
    pending(target)
    for (nm in names(target)) updateSelectInput(session, nm, selected = target[[nm]])
  }
  show_view <- function(v) {
    view(v)
    for (p in NAV_PAGES) shinyjs::toggle(paste0("view_", p), condition = v == p)
    is_day <- !(v %in% NAV_PAGES)
    shinyjs::toggle("view_day", condition = is_day)
    if (is_day) {
      w <- isolate(windows()); push_inputs(w[w$id == v, ])
      chosen_key("shortest")
      focus(NA_character_)
      fit_request(isolate(fit_request()) + 1)
    }
    # a map that was hidden can come up at the wrong size until a resize
    runjs('setTimeout(function () { dispatchEvent(new Event("resize")); }, 60);')
  }
  observeEvent(input$goto, show_view(input$goto))

  # ---- language (Trip settings, R/i18n.R) ----
  # The outputs follow by themselves (tr() reads input$lang); the static page is swapped by www/app.js
  # from the dictionary sent here, and the drop-down choices are put in the language.
  observeEvent(input$lang, {
    session$sendCustomMessage("i18n", list(lang = cur_lang(), dict = as.list(I18N$ui)))
    ch <- start_choices()
    for (id in c("start", "end")) updateSelectInput(session, id, choices = ch, selected = input[[id]])
    updateSelectInput(session, "home", choices = ch[[1]], selected = input$home)
    updateSelectInput(session, "pace", choices = setNames(names(PACES), tr(vapply(PACES, function(p) p$label, character(1)))),
                      selected = input$pace)
  })

  # Top bar: the Overview menu (trip plan, where to eat, where to stay; R/eat_stay.R), then one tab
  # per free time. The free times scroll sideways, with arrows when they do not all fit
  # (www/app.js). Each tab shows the date and hours; the number is how many places are planned in it.
  output$trip_tabs <- renderUI({
    w <- windows(); v <- view(); ds <- day_sel()
    tagList(
      nav_menu(v),
      if (nrow(w)) span(class = "nav-divider"),
      if (nrow(w)) div(class = "date-strip",
        tags$button(class = "strip-arrow left", title = tr("Earlier"), onclick = "scrollTabs(-1)", "‹"),
        div(class = "date-tabs", id = "date_tabs", lapply(seq_len(nrow(w)), function(k) {
          n <- length(ds[[w$id[k]]] %||% character())
          tags$button(
            class = if (v == w$id[k]) "active", onclick = js_input("goto", w$id[k]),
            title = sprintf("%s, %s–%s · %s", fmt_date(w$date[k], "%A %e %B"), fmt_time(w$t0[k]), fmt_time(w$t1[k]),
                            if (n == 0) tr("nothing planned yet") else sprintf(tr("%d place%s planned"), n, pl(n))),
            span(class = "tab-date", fmt_date(w$date[k], "%a %e %b"), if (n > 0) tags$i(n)),
            tags$small(sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_time(w$t0[k]), fmt_time(w$t1[k]))))
        })),
        tags$button(class = "strip-arrow right", title = tr("Later"), onclick = "scrollTabs(1)", "›")))
  })

  # ---- free time ----
  # New or changed free times: the plan keeps what still fits its parts (places of a part that is no
  # longer free move to "any" of their free time; R/slots.R).
  set_windows <- function(ws) {
    ws <- ws[order(ws$date, ws$t0), ]
    windows(ws)
    set_slots(prune_slots(ws, window_parts(ws), isolate(slots()), isolate(slot_walks())))
  }
  observeEvent(input$find_free, {
    if (is.null(input$ics)) { showNotification(tr("Choose a calendar file (.ics) first."), type = "warning"); return() }
    ev <- tryCatch(parse_ics(input$ics$datapath), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ev)) { showNotification(tr("That file could not be read as a calendar."), type = "error"); return() }
    dates <- seq(input$trip_dates[1], input$trip_dates[2], by = 1)
    ws <- free_windows(ev, dates, D, home = input$home, day_start = hhmm_to_min(input$day_from),
                       day_end = hhmm_to_min(input$day_to))
    if (nrow(ws) == 0) { showNotification(tr("No free time of 90 minutes or more on those days."), type = "warning"); return() }
    # a new calendar: what was planned is placed again, as + would
    ids <- planned_ids(isolate(slots()))
    windows(ws[order(ws$date, ws$t0), ])
    f <- auto_fill(D, B, windows(), ids, isolate(pace()))
    set_slots(f)
    example_on(NA)
    show_view("overview")
    runjs("closeFreeTimes()")
    showNotification(sprintf(tr("Found %d free times in %d events."), nrow(ws), sum(!ev$allday)), duration = 4)
  })
  observeEvent(input$remove_window, {
    ws <- windows(); set_windows(ws[ws$id != input$remove_window, ])
    if (view() == input$remove_window) show_view("overview")
  })
  observeEvent(input$edit_window, {
    e <- input$edit_window
    ws <- windows(); k <- which(ws$id == e$id)
    if (length(k) == 0) return()
    if (e$field %in% c("t0", "t1")) {
      v <- hhmm_to_min(e$value)
      t0 <- if (e$field == "t0") v else ws$t0[k]; t1 <- if (e$field == "t1") v else ws$t1[k]
      if (t1 - t0 < 30) {
        showNotification(tr("A free time needs at least 30 minutes."), type = "warning")
        return()
      }
      ws$t0[k] <- t0; ws$t1[k] <- t1
      if (e$field == "t0") { ws$base_t0[k] <- t0; ws$rest[k] <- 0 }
    } else if (e$field == "start") {
      ws$start[k] <- e$value; ws$base_start[k] <- e$value; ws$rest[k] <- 0; ws$start_auto[k] <- FALSE
    } else if (e$field == "end") {
      ws$end[k] <- e$value; ws$end_auto[k] <- FALSE
    }
    set_windows(ws)
  })

  observeEvent(input$example, {
    ex <- EXAMPLES[[input$example]]
    st <- load_example(input$example)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "indoor", value = ex$indoor)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "free", value = ex$free)
    updateSelectInput(session, "home", selected = ex$home %||% "southern_cross")
    windows(st$windows)
    set_slots(st)
    example_on(input$example)
    runjs(sprintf("setPoolFilter('indoor', %s); setPoolFilter('free', %s)", tolower(ex$indoor), tolower(ex$free)))
    runjs("closeFreeTimes()")
    show_view(if (nrow(st$windows) > 1) "overview" else st$windows$id[1])
  })
  output$example_ics <- downloadHandler(
    filename = "example_calendar_conference.ics",
    content = function(file) file.copy(EXAMPLES$conference$ics, file))
  # the same plans as the PDF and the day pages (R/calendar.R)
  ics_download <- function() downloadHandler(
    filename = "melbourne_in_n_hours_plan.ics",
    content = function(file) writeLines(plan_ics(windows(), lapply(export_plans(), function(p) p$opt), D), file, sep = "\r\n"))
  output$plan_ics <- ics_download()
  output$plan_ics_export <- ics_download()

  # ---- home page: places into parts of the days (R/slots.R, R/overview.R) ----
  parts <- reactive(window_parts(windows()))
  fits_now <- reactive(fit_table(D, B, parts(), slots(), pace()))
  suggestions <- reactive(slot_suggestions(D, B, parts(), slots(), slot_walks(), pace()))
  item_name <- function(item) {
    id <- sub("^[a-z]+:", "", item)
    if (startsWith(item, "walk:")) bundle_name(B, match(id, B$id)) else place_name(D, match(id, D$places$id))
  }
  part_label <- function(key) {
    w <- windows()[windows()$id == slot_window(key), ]
    paste0(fmt_date(w$date, "%A"), if (is_zh()) "" else " ", tr(tolower(PARTS$label[match(slot_part(key), PARTS$part)])))
  }
  # Put `item` into part `key` if it can go there; say why not, or that it is tight.
  put_item <- function(key, item) {
    pt <- parts()
    if (!(key %in% pt$key)) return(FALSE)
    chk <- drop_check(D, B, pt, slots(), key, item, pace())
    if (chk$status == "no") {
      showNotification(sprintf(tr("%s does not fit %s. %s"), item_name(item), part_label(key), chk$why), type = "warning", duration = 5)
      return(FALSE)
    }
    gone <- if (startsWith(item, "walk:")) setdiff(slots()[[key]], D$places$id[B$core[[match(sub("^walk:", "", item), B$id)]]])
    set_slots(slot_put(D, B, slots(), slot_walks(), key, item))
    if (chk$status == "tight")
      showNotification(sprintf(tr("%s is in, but %s is now tight: less than a quarter of it is left free."), item_name(item), part_label(key)),
                       duration = 4)
    if (length(gone))
      showNotification(sprintf(tr("The walk took the place of %s."), paste(place_name(D, match(gone, D$places$id)), collapse = if (is_zh()) "\u3001" else ", ")),
                       duration = 4)
    TRUE
  }
  # Dragged from the right into a part, or between parts; dropped on the places list = taken out.
  # On a day page: dragged from the list into the plan ("day") = added to this free time, as a
  # click on its name would.
  observeEvent(input$slot_drop, {
    d <- input$slot_drop
    if (identical(d$to, "pool")) {
      if (startsWith(d$item, "place:")) set_slots(slot_remove(slots(), slot_walks(), sub("^place:", "", d$item)))
      return()
    }
    if (identical(d$to, "day")) {
      id <- sub("^place:", "", d$item)
      if (startsWith(d$item, "place:") && !is.null(active_w()) && !(id %in% sel())) {
        toggle_place(id)
        session$sendCustomMessage("flash-stop", id)   # the new stop lights up in "Your day"
      }
      return()
    }
    put_item(d$to, d$item)
  })
  observeEvent(input$slot_add, {
    key <- auto_slot(D, B, windows(), parts(), slots(), input$slot_add, pace())
    if (is.na(key)) {
      showNotification(sprintf(if (startsWith(input$slot_add, "walk:")) tr("%s does not fit any part of your free time that is still open and empty.")
                               else tr("%s does not fit any part of your free time that is still open."), item_name(input$slot_add)),
                       type = "warning", duration = 5)
      return()
    }
    if (put_item(key, input$slot_add)) showNotification(sprintf(tr("Added to %s."), part_label(key)), duration = 3)
  })
  observeEvent(input$slot_remove, set_slots(slot_remove(slots(), slot_walks(), input$slot_remove)))
  observeEvent(input$slot_clear, {
    sl <- slots(); sl[[input$slot_clear]] <- NULL
    wk <- slot_walks(); wk[[input$slot_clear]] <- NULL
    set_slots(list(slots = sl, walks = wk))
  })
  observeEvent(input$take_suggestion, {
    k <- suggestions()[[input$take_suggestion]]
    if (!is.null(k)) put_item(input$take_suggestion, paste0("walk:", B$id[k]))
  })
  # Every empty part gets its suggested walk at once.
  observeEvent(input$take_all, {
    sg <- suggestions()
    if (length(sg) == 0) return()
    r <- list(slots = slots(), walks = slot_walks())
    for (key in names(sg)) r <- slot_put(D, B, r$slots, r$walks, key, paste0("walk:", B$id[sg[[key]]]))
    set_slots(r)
    showNotification(sprintf(tr("Took %d walk%s."), length(sg), pl(length(sg))), duration = 3)
  })
  observeEvent(input$clear_all, set_slots(list(slots = list(), walks = list())))
  allowed <- reactive({
    ok <- D$places$category != FOOD_CATEGORY | D$places$id %in% food_saved()   # restaurants: only the saved ones
    if (isTRUE(input$indoor)) ok <- ok & D$places$setting == "indoor"
    if (isTRUE(input$free)) ok <- ok & grepl("^free", D$places$entry)
    ok
  })
  output$overview <- renderUI({
    ws <- windows()
    # the card above the days: where the free times come from, and the gear that opens their settings
    ex <- example_on()
    total <- sum(ws$t1 - ws$t0)
    span_txt <- if (nrow(ws)) paste(unique(vapply(range(ws$date), fmt_date, character(1))), collapse = " – ") else ""
    bar <- div(class = paste("calendar-bar", if (!is.na(ex)) "example"),
      span(class = "calendar-bar-icon", if (!is.na(ex)) "✦" else ICON$calendar),
      div(strong(if (!is.na(ex)) sprintf(tr("Example: %s"), tr(EXAMPLES[[ex]]$title))
                 else sprintf(tr("%d free time%s · %s in total"), nrow(ws), pl(nrow(ws)), fmt_dur(total))),
          p(if (!is.na(ex)) sprintf(tr("%s. %d free times, %s in total (%s). Replace it with your own whenever you like."),
                                    if (!is.null(EXAMPLES[[ex]]$ics)) tr("A made-up conference schedule (sessions at MCEC, flight home on Saturday)")
                                    else tr(EXAMPLES[[ex]]$sub), nrow(ws), fmt_dur(total), span_txt)
            else sprintf(tr("%s. Drag a day's white bar to change its hours, + Add a day at the bottom, × to remove one."), span_txt),
            trip_total(day_sums()))),
      if (!is.na(ex)) tags$button(class = "btn secondary", onclick = "openFreeTimes('import')", tr("Use my own calendar")))
    home_ui(D, B, ws, parts(), slots(), slot_walks(), suggestions(), fits_now(), day_sums(), CITY_BUSY, pace(), bar)
  })

  # ---- one free time ----
  observeEvent(list(input$start, input$t0, input$back, input$end), {
    w <- active_w()
    if (is.null(w)) return()
    tg <- pending()
    cur <- list(start = input$start, t0 = input$t0, back = input$back, end = input$end)
    if (!is.null(tg)) {                       # still pushing this window's values to the inputs
      if (identical(cur, tg)) pending(NULL)
      return()
    }
    ws <- windows(); k <- which(ws$id == w$id)
    nt0 <- hhmm_to_min(input$t0); nt1 <- hhmm_to_min(input$back)
    if (ws$start[k] == input$start && ws$end[k] == input$end && ws$t0[k] == nt0 && ws$t1[k] == nt1) return()
    if (ws$start[k] != input$start || ws$t0[k] != nt0) {   # a new starting point replaces any rest
      ws$base_start[k] <- input$start; ws$base_t0[k] <- nt0; ws$rest[k] <- 0
    }
    if (ws$start[k] != input$start) ws$start_auto[k] <- FALSE   # chosen here: no longer "where you stay"
    if (ws$end[k] != input$end) ws$end_auto[k] <- FALSE
    ws$start[k] <- input$start; ws$end[k] <- input$end; ws$t0[k] <- nt0; ws$t1[k] <- nt1
    windows(ws)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # "Rest first": go to where you are staying, rest, and only then set off from there. The leave
  # time becomes the real start of the free time + the walk there + the rest (to the next quarter hour).
  # Where you stay that day: the night's place chosen on Where to stay (that night, else the night
  # before), else Staying near in Trip settings.
  home <- reactive(input$home %||% "flinders_st_stn")
  rest_home <- function(date) {
    s <- stay_node(date); if (is.na(s)) s <- stay_node(date - 1)
    if (is.na(s)) home() else s
  }
  output$rest_ui <- renderUI({
    w <- active_w(); req(w)
    div(class = "rest",
      span(class = "rest-label", tr("Rest first")),
      lapply(c(0, 15, 30, 45, 60), function(m) tags$button(
        class = if (w$rest == m) "active",
        onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('set_rest', %d, {priority: 'event'})", m),
        if (m == 0) tr("No") else fmt_dur(m))),
      tags$small(sprintf(tr("at %s"), node_name(rest_home(w$date)))))
  })
  observeEvent(input$set_rest, {
    w <- active_w(); req(w)
    m <- as.numeric(input$set_rest)
    ws <- windows(); k <- which(ws$id == w$id)
    if (m == 0) {
      t0 <- ws$base_t0[k]; st <- ws$base_start[k]
    } else {
      rh <- rest_home(ws$date[k])
      walk <- D$W[match(ws$base_start[k], D$nodes), match(rh, D$nodes)] * PACES[[pace()]]$walk
      t0 <- ceiling((ws$base_t0[k] + walk + m) / 15) * 15; st <- rh
    }
    if (ws$t1[k] - t0 < 30) { showNotification(tr("Not enough of this free time is left after that rest."), type = "warning"); return() }
    ws$t0[k] <- t0; ws$start[k] <- st; ws$rest[k] <- m
    windows(ws)
    push_inputs(ws[k, ])
  })

  # The planning context of any free time: places in a part of the day are visited no earlier than
  # that part starts (or their walk's start time; R/slots.R).
  window_ctx <- function(w) {
    cx <- make_window_ctx(D, w, pace())
    nb <- slot_not_before(D, B, parts(), slots(), slot_walks(), w$id)
    if (any(!is.na(nb))) cx$not_before <- nb
    cx
  }
  # Keep the parts in time order (morning, afternoon, evening); places added on the day page may go anywhere.
  window_groups <- function(wid, s) slot_groups(slots(), wid, s)
  ctx <- reactive({
    w <- active_w(); req(w)
    window_ctx(w)
  })
  # Per free time with something planned: its shortest-walk plan (the same one the day page opens on),
  # for the sums below.
  day_plans <- reactive({
    ws <- windows(); ds <- day_sel()
    out <- list()
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(ws))) {
      s <- ds[[ws$id[k]]] %||% character()
      if (length(s) == 0) next
      cx <- window_ctx(ws[k, ])
      p <- plan_trip(match(s, D$places$id), cx, window_groups(ws$id[k], s))
      out[[ws$id[k]]] <- list(opt = p$options$shortest, feasible = p$feasible, cx = cx)
    }
    out
  })
  # Minutes on the go (stays + walks, from the start and back), steps and spare time of those plans;
  # `parts` = the same plan's minutes per part of the day, for the home page (R/slots.R part_minutes).
  day_sums <- reactive({
    Map(function(d, wid) {
      ef <- outing_effort(D, d$opt$order, pace(), d$cx$start_id, d$cx$end_id)
      list(minutes = ef$minutes, steps = ef$steps, spare = d$cx$deadline - d$opt$finish, fits = d$feasible,
           parts = part_minutes(parts(), wid, d$opt, d$cx))
    }, day_plans(), names(day_plans()))
  })
  sel <- reactive({
    w <- active_w()
    if (is.null(w)) character() else day_sel()[[w$id]] %||% character()
  })
  # Added or taken out on a day page. An addition goes to "any" of this free time (it may go anywhere in
  # the order) and leaves any other part it was in; a place lives in one free time only.
  toggle_place <- function(id) {
    s <- isolate(sel())
    wid <- isolate(active_w())$id
    if (id %in% s) {
      set_slots(slot_remove(isolate(slots()), isolate(slot_walks()), id))
    } else if (length(s) >= MAX_STOPS) {
      showNotification(sprintf(tr("Up to %d stops in one free time."), MAX_STOPS), type = "warning")
    } else {
      set_slots(slot_put(D, B, isolate(slots()), isolate(slot_walks()), slot_key(wid, SLOT_ANY), paste0("place:", id)))
    }
  }
  observeEvent(input$toggle_place, toggle_place(input$toggle_place))
  observeEvent(input$map_marker_click, {
    id <- input$map_marker_click$id
    if (!is.null(id) && id %in% D$places$id) focus(id)   # a marker opens the same popup
  })
  observeEvent(input$option, chosen_key(input$option))
  observeEvent(input$set_leave, updateSelectInput(session, "t0", selected = input$set_leave))

  time_ok <-reactive(ctx()$deadline > ctx()$t0 + 15)
  alone <- reactive(fits_alone(ctx()))
  sel_groups <- reactive(window_groups(active_w()$id, sel()))
  plan <- reactive({
    if (length(sel()) == 0 || !time_ok()) return(NULL)
    plan_trip(match(sel(), D$places$id), ctx(), sel_groups())
  })
  chosen <- reactive({
    p <- plan()
    if (is.null(p)) return(NULL)
    k <- if (chosen_key() %in% names(p$options)) chosen_key() else "shortest"
    p$options[[k]]
  })
  # Every place not in this plan that could still join it without breaking it (and how many minutes
  # it adds): for the drag hints on the place list. `fits` keeps the ones shown and not planned on
  # another day, for "Still fits" and the rings on the map.
  fit_extra <- reactive({
    opt <- chosen()
    if (is.null(opt)) return(NULL)
    what_fits(opt, which(!(D$places$id %in% sel()) & alone()), ctx())
  })
  fits <- reactive({
    f <- fit_extra()
    if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
    planned_elsewhere <- unlist(day_sel()[setdiff(names(day_sel()), active_w()$id)])
    f[allowed()[f$place] & !(D$places$id[f$place] %in% planned_elsewhere), , drop = FALSE]
  })

  output$win_day <- renderUI({ w <- active_w(); req(w); p(fmt_date(w$date, "%A %e %B")) })
  output$win_free <- renderUI({ w <- active_w(); req(w); span(sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(w$t1 - w$t0))) })

  # Place list: the places in this plan first (in visiting order); then the saved restaurants and, by
  # category, the places that can be added; then the ones planned on another day (adding moves them here); last, the ones that
  # cannot be visited in this free time, each with the reason. Each row: the name adds it to this day
  # (or takes it out), the i shows what it is in a popup on the map. Rows can also be dragged into the
  # plan; data-fit colours the plan while one is dragged (green: still fits, amber: not with all the
  # others, faded: cannot be visited in this free time) and data-note is the line shown there.
  output$picker <- renderUI({
    s <- sel(); ok <- allowed(); fit <- alone(); cx <- ctx(); opt <- chosen(); extra <- fit_extra()
    elsewhere <- day_sel()[setdiff(names(day_sel()), active_w()$id)]
    in_plan <- if (!is.null(opt)) D$places$id[opt$order] else s
    other_day <- vapply(D$places$id, function(id) {
      k <- names(elsewhere)[vapply(elsewhere, function(x) id %in% x, logical(1))]
      if (length(k)) fmt_date(windows()$date[windows()$id == k[1]], "%a") else NA_character_
    }, character(1))
    rest <- which(ok & !(D$places$id %in% s))
    why <- vapply(rest, function(i) if (fit[i]) "" else unfit_reason(D, i, cx), character(1))
    why_all <- replace(rep("", nrow(D$places)), rest, why)
    drag <- function(i, on) {
      nm <- place_name(D, i)
      k <- if (!is.null(extra)) match(i, extra$place) else NA
      st <- if (on) "here" else if (nzchar(why_all[i])) "no" else if (is.null(opt) || !is.na(k)) "ok" else "tight"
      note <- if (on) ""
              else if (st == "no") sprintf(tr("%s: %s. Drop to add it anyway"), nm, why_all[i])
              else if (!is.na(other_day[i])) sprintf(tr("Drop to move %s here from %s"), nm, other_day[i])
              else if (st == "tight") sprintf(tr("Drop to add %s: too much with the others, we will say what to leave out"), nm)
              else if (is.null(opt)) sprintf(tr("Drop to add %s to this free time"), nm)
              else if (extra$extra[k] < 1) sprintf(tr("Drop to add %s: it still fits, back at the same time"), nm)
              else sprintf(tr("Drop to add %s: it still fits, back %s later"), nm, fmt_dur(extra$extra[k]))
      list(draggable = "true", `data-item` = paste0("place:", D$places$id[i]), `data-from` = if (on) "day",
           `data-fit` = sprintf('{"day":"%s"}', st), `data-note` = note)
    }
    row <- function(i, tag = NULL, state = NULL) {
      p <- D$places[i, ]
      on <- p$id %in% s
      do.call(div, c(list(class = paste("pick", state, if (on) "selected")), drag(i, on), list(
        tags$button(class = "pick-main", onclick = js_input("toggle_place", p$id),
                    title = if (on) tr("Take it out of this day (or drag it back here)") else tr("Add it to this day (or drag it into the plan)"),
                    if (on) tags$i(match(p$id, in_plan)) else tags$b("+"),
                    span(place_name(D, i)), if (!is.null(tag)) tags$small(tag)),
        tags$button(class = "pick-info", title = sprintf(tr("About %s"), place_name(D, i)), onclick = js_input("info_place", p$id), "i"))))
    }
    can <- rest[why == "" & is.na(other_day[rest])]
    moved <- rest[why == "" & !is.na(other_day[rest])]
    cannot <- rest[why != ""]
    div(class = "chips",
      if (length(s)) tagList(strong(tr("On your plan")), lapply(match(in_plan, D$places$id), row)),
      # restaurants the visitor saved first: they chose them already
      lapply(c(FOOD_CATEGORY, CATEGORY_ORDER), function(cat) {
        idx <- can[D$places$category[can] == cat]
        if (length(idx)) tagList(strong(tr(cat)), lapply(idx, function(i) row(i, if (D$places$entry[i] == "paid") "$")))
      }),
      if (length(moved)) tagList(strong(tr("Planned on another day")),
        lapply(moved, function(i) row(i, sprintf(tr("on %s"), other_day[i]), "moved"))),
      if (length(cannot)) tagList(strong(tr("Not possible in this free time")),
        lapply(seq_along(cannot), function(k) row(cannot[k], why[rest == cannot[k]], "unfit"))))
  })
  # About a place: a popup on the map (2D and 3D) for the place whose i, marker or plan row was
  # clicked; its button adds the place to this day or takes it out. The popup's × closes it.
  observeEvent(input$info_place, focus(input$info_place))
  observeEvent(input$popup_closed, focus(NA_character_))
  observe({
    f <- focus(); req(active_w())
    m <- leafletProxy("map") |> removePopup("info")
    if (is.na(f)) { session$sendCustomMessage("map3d-popup", list(html = "")); return() }
    i <- match(f, D$places$id); opt <- chosen()
    stop_no <- if (!is.null(opt)) match(i, opt$order) else NA
    html <- as.character(place_card(i, D, ctx(), f %in% sel(), stop_no, pace()))
    m |> addPopups(lng = D$places$lon[i], lat = D$places$lat[i], popup = html, layerId = "info",
                   options = popupOptions(maxWidth = 300, minWidth = 260, closeOnClick = FALSE, autoClose = FALSE,
                                          className = "place-popup", offset = c(0, -10)))

  observeEvent(input$focus_place, focus(if (nzchar(input$focus_place)) input$focus_place else NA_character_))

  output$status <- renderUI({
    if (!time_ok()) return(div(class = "status bad", ICON$info, div(strong(tr("Check your times")), p(tr("“Back by” needs to be after the time you leave.")))))
    if (length(sel()) == 0) return(div(class = "status", ICON$info, div(strong(tr("Nothing planned yet")), p(tr("Add places from the list on the left or click them on the map.")))))
    p <- plan(); opt <- chosen(); cx <- ctx()
    # unplanned = the free time minus visiting and walking (waiting for a place to open is free time)
    len <- cx$deadline - cx$t0; need <- slack_for(len)
    stay_min <- function(ix) sum(cx$stay[ix]) * PACES[[pace()]]$stay
    unplanned <- len - stay_min(opt$order) - opt$walk_total
    if (p$feasible && opt$n_problems == 0 && opt$late == 0 && unplanned < need) {
      # It fits, but with less than the slack left free: say so, and which stop to leave out for room.
      s <- match(sel(), D$places$id)
      adv <- if (length(s) > 1) drop_advice(s, cx)
      if (!is.null(adv)) {
        adv$free <- len - vapply(adv$drop, function(d) stay_min(setdiff(s, d)), numeric(1)) - adv$walk
        adv <- adv[order(-adv$free), ]
        adv <- head(adv[adv$free >= min(need, max(adv$free)), ], 2)
      }
      return(div(class = "status warn", ICON$info, div(
        strong(sprintf(tr("%s, but it is tight"), if (length(opt$order) == 1) tr("It fits") else sprintf(tr("All %d stops fit"), length(opt$order)))),
        p(sprintf(tr("Only %s of this %s free time is left unplanned. We keep at least %s free for queues, breaks and surprises.%s"),
                  fmt_dur(max(0, unplanned)), fmt_dur(len), fmt_dur(need),
                  if (!is.null(adv) && nrow(adv)) tr(" Leave one out:") else "")),
        if (!is.null(adv)) lapply(seq_len(nrow(adv)), function(r) tags$button(
          onclick = js_input("toggle_place", D$places$id[adv$drop[r]]),
          sprintf(tr("%s × · %s free"), place_name(D, adv$drop[r]), fmt_dur(adv$free[r])))))))
    }
    if (p$feasible) {
      # If the plan waits for a place to open, the visitor could set off later and lose nothing:
      # try leaving later by the first wait (in quarter hours) and keep it only if the finish is the same.
      wait <- opt$start - opt$arrive
      k <- which(wait > 0.5)[1]
      later <- if (!is.na(k)) floor(wait[k] / 15) * 15 else 0
      if (later >= 30) {
        cx2 <- cx; cx2$t0 <- cx$t0 + later
        ev <- evaluate_orders(matrix(opt$order, nrow = 1), cx2)
        if (ev$n_problems > 0 || ev$finish > opt$finish + 0.5) later <- 0
      }
      return(tagList(
        div(class = "status ok", ICON$check, div(
          strong(if (length(opt$order) == 1) tr("It fits") else sprintf(tr("All %d stops fit"), length(opt$order))),
          p(sprintf(tr("Back at %s by %s, %s to spare.%s"), node_name(cx$end_id), fmt_time(opt$finish),
                    fmt_dur(cx$deadline - opt$finish),
                    if (p$n_orders > 1) sprintf(tr(" Checked all %s orders."), format(p$n_orders, big.mark = ",")) else "")))),
        if (later >= 30) tags$button(class = "tip", onclick = js_input("set_leave", fmt_time(cx$t0 + later)),
          span("✦"),
          div(strong(sprintf(tr("Leave at %s, same plan"), fmt_time(cx$t0 + later))),
              tags$small(if (!is.null(cx$not_before) && !is.na(cx$not_before[opt$order[k]]) &&
                             abs(opt$start[k] - cx$not_before[opt$order[k]]) < 0.5)
                           sprintf(tr("Your %s starts at %s at %s"), tr(tolower(PARTS$label[part_of(opt$start[k])])),
                                   place_name(D, opt$order[k]), fmt_time(opt$start[k]))
                         else sprintf(tr("%s opens at %s"), place_name(D, opt$order[k]), fmt_time(opt$start[k])))),
          tags$b(tr("Use time")))))
    }
    why <- c()
    for (k in seq_along(opt$order)) {
      nm <- place_name(D, opt$order[k])
      if (opt$problem[k] == 1) why <- c(why, sprintf(tr("%s is closed on %s"), nm, day_name(cx$day)))
      if (opt$problem[k] == 2) why <- c(why, sprintf(tr("%s closes at %s"), nm, fmt_time(cx$close[opt$order[k]])))
    }
    if (opt$late > 0) why <- c(why, sprintf(tr("you would be back %s late"), fmt_dur(opt$late)))
    adv <- p$drop_advice
    div(class = "status warn", ICON$info, div(
      strong(tr("This plan does not fit")),
      p(paste0(paste(why, collapse = if (is_zh()) "\uff1b" else "; "), if (is_zh()) "\u3002" else ".", if (!is.null(adv)) tr(" Leave one out:") else "")),
      if (!is.null(adv)) lapply(seq_len(min(2, nrow(adv))), function(r) tags$button(
        onclick = js_input("toggle_place", D$places$id[adv$drop[r]]),
        sprintf(tr("%s × · %s spare"), place_name(D, adv$drop[r]), fmt_dur(adv$spare[r])))),
      if (is.null(adv) && pace() != "brisk") p(tr("Try a brisk pace or a later “back by” time."))))
  })

  # Where to stay: one choice per night (R/eat_stay.R nights_for). The list is ranked for the night
  # being chosen (that evening's end point and the next morning's start point), or for the whole trip.
  stay_nights <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  observe({ ws <- windows(); stay_nights(nights_for(ws, isolate(stay_nights()))) })
  stay_active <- reactiveVal(NULL)     # date of the night being chosen, "all", or NULL (= the first night)
  pin_mode <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  night_key <- reactive({
    n <- stay_nights(); a <- stay_active()
    if (is.null(n)) return(NULL)
    keys <- format(n$date[n$on])
    if (identical(a, "all") || (!is.null(a) && a %in% keys)) a else if (length(keys)) keys[1] else NULL
  })
  set_night <- function(keys, vals) {
    n <- stay_nights(); i <- match(keys, format(n$date))
    for (f in names(vals)) n[[f]][i] <- vals[[f]]
    stay_nights(n)
  }
  # The node (start / end point) of the place chosen for a night, or NA.
  stay_node <- function(date) {
    n <- stay_nights(); i <- if (is.null(n)) NA else match(date, n$date)
    if (is.na(i) || !n$on[i] || is.na(n$node[i])) NA_character_ else n$node[i]
  }
  # After a choice, go on to the next night still without one. The place becomes a start / end
  # point of this session's D, so the day pages can set off from it and come back to it.
  chosen_for <- function(key, vals) {
    n <- stay_nights()
    keys <- if (identical(key, "all")) format(n$date[n$on]) else key
    r <- add_stay_node(D, E, vals$name, vals$lon, vals$lat)
    D <<- r$D; E <<- r$E; vals$node <- r$id
    refresh_point_choices()
    set_night(keys, vals)
    n <- stay_nights(); open <- format(n$date[n$on & n$kind == "none"])
    if (!identical(key, "all") && length(open)) stay_active(open[1])
    pin_mode(FALSE)
  }
  observeEvent(input$night_pick, { stay_active(input$night_pick); pin_mode(FALSE) })
  observeEvent(input$night_every, { stay_active("all"); pin_mode(FALSE) })
  observeEvent(input$night_on, set_night(input$night_on$date, list(on = isTRUE(input$night_on$on))))
  observeEvent(input$night_clear, set_night(input$night_clear, list(kind = "none", name = "", address = "", lon = NA_real_,

  observeEvent(input$night_all, {

  # Free times that start or end "where you stay" (start_auto / end_auto) follow the nights: the
  # morning sets off from where you slept, the evening goes back to where you sleep that night;
  # nights not chosen use Staying near (Trip settings). A rest taken first is undone if the start moves.
  observe({
    stay_nights(); h <- home(); ws <- windows()
    if (!nrow(ws)) return()
    new <- ws
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(ws))) {
      if (isTRUE(ws$start_auto[k])) {
        s <- stay_node(ws$date[k] - 1); if (is.na(s)) s <- h
        if (new$base_start[k] != s) { new$base_start[k] <- s; new$start[k] <- s; new$t0[k] <- new$base_t0[k]; new$rest[k] <- 0 }
      }
      if (isTRUE(ws$end_auto[k])) { e <- stay_node(ws$date[k]); if (is.na(e)) e <- h; new$end[k] <- e }
    }
    if (!identical(new, ws)) {
      windows(new)
      a <- isolate(active_w())
      if (!is.null(a)) { refresh_point_choices(); push_inputs(new[new$id == a$id, ]) }
    }
  })
  observeEvent(input$stay_pick, {     # "Stay here" in a hotel's popup on the map

    s <- E$stay[E$stay$id == input$stay_pick, ]

  })
  # The one search box (hotels and addresses together; www/app.js staySearch): suggestions go back
  # to the box that asked; a picked one is that night's place (or every night's, for "all").
  observeEvent(input$stay_q, {
    q <- input$stay_q$q %||% ""
    items <- search_stays(E, q)
    items <- lapply(items, function(it) c(it, icon = if (it$kind == "hotel") "🏨" else "📍"))
    session$sendCustomMessage("stay-suggest", list(night = input$stay_q$night, q = q, items = items,
      none = tr("Nothing found in the City of Melbourne. Check the spelling, or click the place on the map.")))
  })
  observeEvent(input$stay_choose, {
    ch <- input$stay_choose
    if (ch$night %in% c("pt_start", "pt_end")) {      # the day page: start or end somewhere else
      w <- active_w(); req(w)
      v <- stay_pick_vals(E, ch$kind, ch$id)
      pt <- add_stay_node(D, E, v$name, v$lon, v$lat, prefix = "pt", note = "added by the visitor")
      D <<- pt$D; E <<- pt$E
      ws <- windows(); k <- which(ws$id == w$id)
      if (ch$night == "pt_start") {
        ws$start[k] <- pt$id; ws$base_start[k] <- pt$id; ws$t0[k] <- ws$base_t0[k]; ws$rest[k] <- 0; ws$start_auto[k] <- FALSE
      } else {
        ws$end[k] <- pt$id; ws$end_auto[k] <- FALSE
      }
      refresh_point_choices()
      windows(ws); push_inputs(ws[k, ])
      runjs("toggleOwnPoint(false)")
      return()
    }
    if (ch$night == "all") stay_active("all")
    chosen_for(ch$night, stay_pick_vals(E, ch$kind, ch$id))
  })
  observeEvent(input$night_pin, { stay_active(input$night_pin); pin_mode(!isolate(pin_mode())) })
  observeEvent(input$stay_map_click, {
    if (!pin_mode()) return()
    k <- night_key(); req(k); cl <- input$stay_map_click
    chosen_for(k, list(kind = "pin", name = tr("Your own place (on the map)"), address = near_address(E, cl$lng, cl$lat),
                       lon = cl$lng, lat = cl$lat))
  })
  stay_points <- reactive({
    k <- night_key(); ws <- windows()
    pts <- if (!is.null(k) && !identical(k, "all")) night_points(D, ws, day_plans(), as.Date(k)) else NULL
    pts <- unname(pts[!is.na(pts)])
    if (length(pts)) pts else trip_points(D, ws, day_sel())
  })
  stay_ranked <- reactive(stay_rank(E, stay_points(), pace()))
  output$stay_nights_ui <- renderUI({
    n <- stay_nights(); k <- night_key()
    tagList(
      nights_ui(D, E, n, windows(), day_plans(), k, pin_mode(), pace()),
      if (!is.null(n)) div(class = "nights-every",
        tags$button(type = "button", class = paste("btn secondary", if (identical(k, "all")) "on"),
                    onclick = js_input("night_every", "all"), tr("One place for every night")),
        if (identical(k, "all")) tagList(
          span(class = "muted", tr("What you choose now is used for every night.")),
          stay_search_box("all"))))
  })
  output$stay_map <- renderLeaflet(es_base_map())
  outputOptions(output, "stay_map", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
  observe({
    req(view() == "stay")
    r <- stay_ranked(); pts <- stay_points(); n <- stay_nights(); k <- night_key()
    m <- leafletProxy("stay_map") |> clearGroup("stays") |> clearGroup("trip") |> clearGroup("nights") |> clearControls()
    if (is.null(r)) return()
    pick <- if (is.null(k)) "" else sprintf(
      '<br><button type="button" class="btn primary map-pick" onclick="Shiny.setInputValue(\'stay_pick\', %%d, {priority: \'event\'})">%s</button>',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(if (identical(k, "all")) tr("Stay here every night") else sprintf(tr("Stay here: %s"), night_label(as.Date(k)))))
    pop <- sprintf('<b><a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a></b><br>%s<br>%s%s',
                   gmaps_search(r$name, r$address), htmltools::htmlEscape(r$name), htmltools::htmlEscape(r$address),
                   sprintf(tr("About %d min on foot on average"), as.integer(round(r$avg))),
                   if (nzchar(pick)) sprintf(pick, r$id) else "")
    m <- m |>
      addCircleMarkers(lng = r$lon, lat = r$lat, group = "stays", layerId = paste0("stay:", r$id), radius = 6,
                       color = "#fff", weight = 1, fillColor = stay_col(r$avg), fillOpacity = .9,
                       label = sprintf(tr("%s · %d min on average"), r$name, as.integer(round(r$avg))), popup = pop)
    m <- m |>
      addCircleMarkers(lng = E$node_lon[pts], lat = E$node_lat[pts], group = "trip", radius = 7, color = "#fff",
                       weight = 2, fillColor = BRAND_BLUE, fillOpacity = 1, label = vapply(pts, node_label, ""))
    m <- m |>
      addLegend("bottomright", colors = rev(STAY_COLS), labels = tr(c("under 10 min", "10–15 min", "15–20 min", "20 min or more")),
                title = tr("Hotels: average walk to the blue points"), opacity = 1)
    ch <- if (!is.null(n)) n[n$on & n$kind != "none", ] else NULL
    if (!is.null(ch) && nrow(ch))
      m <- m |> addMarkers(lng = ch$lon, lat = ch$lat, group = "nights",
                           label = sprintf("%s · %s", vapply(ch$date, night_label, ""), ch$name))
  })
  # Fit the map when the page opens or another night is picked (not on every choice): the points of
  # that night and the closest hotels.
  observe({
    req(view() == "stay"); night_key()
    r <- isolate(stay_ranked()); pts <- isolate(stay_points())
    req(!is.null(r))
    top <- head(r, STAY_SHOW)
    es_fit("stay_map", c(E$node_lon[pts], top$lon), c(E$node_lat[pts], top$lat))
  })
  observe(session$sendCustomMessage("stay-pin-mode", isTRUE(pin_mode())))

  # "+ Add a day" under the days on the trip plan: the day after the last one, 10:00 to 17:00 from and
  # back to where you stay (the nights on Where to stay, else Staying near); drag the white bar's ends.
  observeEvent(input$add_day, {
    ws <- windows()
    d <- if (nrow(ws)) max(ws$date) + 1 else as.Date(format(Sys.time(), tz = "Australia/Melbourne"))
    id <- sprintf("w%d", if (nrow(ws)) max(as.integer(sub("w", "", ws$id))) + 1 else 1)
    home <- input$home %||% "flinders_st_stn"
    set_windows(rbind(ws, manual_window(id, d, 10 * 60, 17 * 60, home, home, auto = TRUE)))
    example_on(NA)
    showNotification(sprintf(tr("Added %s, 10:00–17:00. Drag the ends of its white bar to change it."), fmt_date(d, "%A %e %B")),
                     duration = 5)
  })

  # ---- 3D map (www/map3d.js) ----
  # The same plan as the 2D map: route legs, numbered stops coloured by street busyness (their
  # buildings take the same colour), start and end. Sent whenever the plan changes while 3D is on.
  # A leg's street line, or a straight line where none is stored (to and from where you stay; the
  # walk itself is estimated, R/eat_stay.R); NULL when both ends are the same point.
  leg_or_line <- function(a, b) {
    if (a == b) return(NULL)
    leg_coords(D, a, b) %||% rbind(node_ll(a), node_ll(b))
  }
  node_ll <- function(id) {
    if (id %in% D$places$id) c(D$places$lon[D$places$id == id], D$places$lat[D$places$id == id])
    else c(D$starts$lon[D$starts$id == id], D$starts$lat[D$starts$id == id])
  }
  map_mode <- reactive(input$map_mode %||% "2d")
  observeEvent(input$map_mode, session$sendCustomMessage("map3d-show", input$map_mode == "3d"))
  last_fit_3d <- reactiveVal(-1)
  observe({
    req(map_mode() == "3d")
    cx <- ctx(); opt <- chosen(); pl <- D$places
    refit <- fit_request() != isolate(last_fit_3d())
    last_fit_3d(fit_request())
    ids <- c(cx$start_id, if (!is.null(opt)) pl$id[opt$order], cx$end_id)
    legs <- lapply(seq_len(length(ids) - 1), function(k) {
      xy <- leg_or_line(ids[k], ids[k + 1])                 # NULL when start and end are the same point
      if (is.null(xy)) return(NULL)
      list(coords = lapply(seq_len(nrow(xy)), function(r) unname(xy[r, ])), back = k == length(ids) - 1)
    })
    legs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), legs)
    stops <- if (is.null(opt)) list() else lapply(seq_along(opt$order), function(k) {
      i <- opt$order[k]; lv <- busy_level(opt$busy[k], D$busy_cuts)
      list(id = pl$id[i], n = k, lon = pl$lon[i], lat = pl$lat[i], name = place_name(D, i),
           color = busy_col(lv), dark = !is.na(lv) && lv == 3, problem = opt$problem[k] > 0, building = TRUE,
           label = sprintf(tr("%d. %s — arrive %s (%s)"), k, place_name(D, i), fmt_time(opt$arrive[k]),
                           if (is.na(lv)) tr("no street count") else tr(BUSY_LABELS[lv])))
    })
    ends <- list(c(list(kind = "start", label = sprintf(tr("Start: %s"), node_name(cx$start_id))),
                   setNames(as.list(node_ll(cx$start_id)), c("lon", "lat"))))
    if (cx$end_id != cx$start_id)
      ends[[2]] <- c(list(kind = "end", label = sprintf(tr("Back at: %s"), node_name(cx$end_id))),
                     setNames(as.list(node_ll(cx$end_id)), c("lon", "lat")))
    all <- do.call(rbind, c(lapply(legs, function(l) do.call(rbind, l$coords)), list(t(sapply(ids, node_ll)))))
    session$sendCustomMessage("map3d", list(legs = legs, stops = stops, ends = ends, refit = refit,
                                            fit = c(min(all[, 1]), min(all[, 2]), max(all[, 1]), max(all[, 2]))))
  })

  # ---- map ----
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    # The base map is greyed (www/style.css, as in the 3D view) so the route and the stops stand out;
    # a scale bar under the zoom buttons for judging walking distances.
    # Zoom buttons and the scale bar sit top right; the 2D / 3D switch top left.
    leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, minZoom = 12)) |>
      addTiles(attribution = "© OpenStreetMap contributors") |>
      addScaleBar(position = "topright", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE)) |>
      setView(144.9631, -37.8150, 14) |>
      htmlwidgets::onRender("function (el) { L.control.zoom({ position: 'topright' }).addTo(this); }")
  })
  outputOptions(output, "map", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

  observe({
    cx <- ctx(); s <- sel(); ok <- allowed(); fit <- alone(); opt <- chosen(); f <- fits()
    pl <- D$places
    m <- leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("places") |> clearGroup("route") |> clearGroup("stops") |>
      clearGroup("fits") |> clearGroup("ends") |> clearGroup("hover")
    if (!is.null(opt)) {
      ids <- c(cx$start_id, pl$id[opt$order], cx$end_id)
      for (k in seq_len(length(ids) - 1)) {
        xy <- leg_or_line(ids[k], ids[k + 1])
        if (is.null(xy)) next
        m <- m |>
          addPolylines(lng = xy[, 1], lat = xy[, 2], group = "route", color = "#FFFFFF", weight = 8, opacity = 0.9) |>
          addPolylines(lng = xy[, 1], lat = xy[, 2], group = "route", color = "#0071E3", weight = 4, opacity = 0.9,
                       dashArray = if (k == length(ids) - 1) "6 6" else NULL)
      }
    }
    other <- which(!(pl$id %in% s) & ok)
    if (length(other)) {
      closed <- is.na(cx$open[other])
      good <- fit[other] & !closed
      m <- m |> addCircleMarkers(
        lng = pl$lon[other], lat = pl$lat[other], layerId = pl$id[other], group = "places",
        radius = ifelse(good, 5, 4), stroke = TRUE, weight = 1.5, color = "#FFFFFF",      # background: light grey
        fillColor = ifelse(good, "#8E8E93", "#C7C7CC"), fillOpacity = ifelse(good, 0.9, 0.7),
        label = sprintf("%s — %s", place_name(D, other),
                        ifelse(closed, tr("closed this day"), ifelse(good, tr("click for details"), tr("too far for this free time")))))
    }
    if (!is.null(f) && nrow(f) > 0) {
      f <- head(f, 3)
      m <- m |> addCircleMarkers(lng = pl$lon[f$place], lat = pl$lat[f$place], group = "fits",
                                 radius = 11, fill = FALSE, color = "#16A34A", weight = 2, dashArray = "3 3",
                                 options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))
    }
    st <- c(cx$start_id, cx$end_id)
    ll <- t(sapply(st, function(id) if (id %in% pl$id) c(pl$lon[pl$id == id], pl$lat[pl$id == id])
                                   else c(D$starts$lon[D$starts$id == id], D$starts$lat[D$starts$id == id])))
    m <- m |> addCircleMarkers(lng = ll[1, 1], lat = ll[1, 2], group = "ends", radius = 9, color = "#0F172A",
                               weight = 3, fillColor = "#FFFFFF", fillOpacity = 1,
                               label = sprintf(tr("Start: %s"), node_name(cx$start_id)))
    if (cx$end_id != cx$start_id)
      m <- m |> addCircleMarkers(lng = ll[2, 1], lat = ll[2, 2], group = "ends", radius = 9, color = "#0F172A",
                                 weight = 3, fillColor = "#0F172A", fillOpacity = 1,
                                 label = sprintf(tr("Back at: %s"), node_name(cx$end_id)))
    if (!is.null(opt)) {
      i <- opt$order
      lv <- busy_level(opt$busy, D$busy_cuts)
      m <- m |>
        addCircleMarkers(lng = pl$lon[i], lat = pl$lat[i], layerId = pl$id[i], group = "stops",
                         radius = 13, color = ifelse(opt$problem > 0, "#DC2626", "#FFFFFF"), weight = 2.5,
                         fillColor = busy_col(lv), fillOpacity = 1,
                         label = sprintf(tr("%d. %s — arrive %s (%s)"), seq_along(i), place_name(D, i), fmt_time(opt$arrive),
                                         ifelse(is.na(lv), tr("no street count"), tr(BUSY_LABELS[lv])))) |>
        addLabelOnlyMarkers(lng = pl$lon[i], lat = pl$lat[i], group = "stops", label = as.character(seq_along(i)),
                            labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", textOnly = TRUE,
                                                        className = ifelse(!is.na(lv) & lv == 3, "stop-num dark", "stop-num")))
    }
  })

  # zoom to the plan (or the start) when a free time is opened
  observeEvent(fit_request(), {
    cx <- ctx(); opt <- chosen()
    pts <- if (!is.null(opt)) opt$order else integer()
    st <- c(cx$start_id, cx$end_id)
    # unname: a named vector would reach Leaflet as a JSON object, not a [lat, lng] pair
    lon <- unname(c(D$places$lon[pts], sapply(st, function(id) if (id %in% D$places$id) D$places$lon[D$places$id == id] else D$starts$lon[D$starts$id == id])))
    lat <- unname(c(D$places$lat[pts], sapply(st, function(id) if (id %in% D$places$id) D$places$lat[D$places$id == id] else D$starts$lat[D$starts$id == id])))
    # with no stops yet (start and end close together) show the streets around the start instead of
    # zooming in on a single point
    if (diff(range(lon)) < 0.004 && diff(range(lat)) < 0.003) {
      leafletProxy("map") |> setView(lon[1], lat[1], zoom = 15, options = list(animate = FALSE))
    } else {
      leafletProxy("map") |> fitBounds(min(lon), min(lat), max(lon), max(lat),
                                       options = list(paddingTopLeft = c(40, 50), paddingBottomRight = c(40, 60)))
    }
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # ring on the map around the place in the card, or a stop hovered in the plan
  highlight <- reactiveVal(NA_character_)
  observeEvent(focus(), highlight(focus()), ignoreNULL = FALSE)
  observeEvent(input$hover_place, highlight(input$hover_place))
  observe({
    id <- highlight()
    req(active_w())
    m <- leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("hover")
    if (is.na(id)) return()
    i <- match(id, D$places$id)
    m |> addCircleMarkers(lng = D$places$lon[i], lat = D$places$lat[i], group = "hover", radius = 19,
                          fill = FALSE, color = "#0071E3", weight = 3, options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))
  })
}

name: R/bundles.R
content:
# Ready-made walks: a few places walked together, mostly along one of the City of Melbourne's
# self-guided walks (data/bundles.csv, a team-made table; the core stops are planned, the extra stops
# are ideas only). On the home page they sit at the top of the places on the right and can be dragged
# into a part of a free time (R/slots.R); an empty part shows the best one as a suggestion.
#
# Each free time is split into parts (morning 8-12, afternoon 12-17, evening 17-22); a part counts if at
# least MIN_PART minutes of it are free. A walk fits a part if every core stop is open long enough
# inside the part, and the stays plus the walks between the stops (nearest-neighbour order) leave at
# least the slack free (slack_for(), R/planner.R: a quarter of the part, at least 30 minutes, for
# getting there, breaks and surprises). This is a quick screen; the day page then checks the real plan
# exactly, including the walk from the start point. Ranking among the walks that fit: the City's
# official walks first, then the team's suggested time of day, then the theme, then how quiet the
# streets by its stops are at that hour (pedestrian sensors, compared with the same streets' busiest
# hour, the way Google Maps shows "popular times").

THEMES <- c(culture = "Culture & history", nature = "Nature & gardens", views = "Views & photos",
            lanes = "Lanes, food & shopping")
THEME_ICONS <- c(culture = "🏛️", nature = "🌿", views = "📷", lanes = "☕")
PARTS <- data.frame(part = c("morning", "afternoon", "evening"), label = c("Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening"),
                    from = c(8, 12, 17) * 60, to = c(12, 17, 22) * 60)
MIN_PART <- 60

load_bundles <- function(D, file) {
  b <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "")
  ids <- function(x) lapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x), " ", fixed = TRUE), function(v) {
    i <- match(v[nzchar(v)], D$places$id)
    if (anyNA(i)) stop("unknown place in ", file, ": ", paste(v[nzchar(v)][is.na(i)], collapse = ", "))
    i
  })
  b$themes <- strsplit(b$themes, " ", fixed = TRUE)
  b$core <- ids(b$core)
  b$extra <- ids(b$extra)
  # not_before: the walk is planned to start no earlier than this (e.g. for the sunset)
  b$not_before <- vapply(b$not_before, function(x) if (is.na(x)) NA_real_ else hhmm_to_min(x), numeric(1))
  b
}

# The part as this bundle would use it: a walk with a not_before time starts no earlier than that.
bundle_part <- function(B, k, part) {
  if (!is.na(B$not_before[k])) part$t0 <- max(part$t0, B$not_before[k])
  part
}

# One row per usable part of each free time; key = "<window id>|<part>".
# Part number (1 morning, 2 afternoon, 3 evening) of time t (minutes).
part_of <- function(t) findInterval(t, c(-Inf, PARTS$to[1:2]))

window_parts <- function(ws) {
  rows <- list()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(ws))) for (j in seq_len(nrow(PARTS))) {
    a <- max(ws$t0[k], PARTS$from[j]); b <- min(ws$t1[k], PARTS$to[j])
    if (b - a >= MIN_PART) rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      key = paste(ws$id[k], PARTS$part[j], sep = "|"), window = ws$id[k], part = PARTS$part[j],
      label = PARTS$label[j], t0 = a, t1 = b, day = as.integer(format(ws$date[k], "%u")))
  }
  if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows)
  else data.frame(key = character(), window = character(), part = character(), label = character(),
                  t0 = numeric(), t1 = numeric(), day = integer())
}

# Visiting order (nearest neighbour from the first stop) and minutes of stays plus walks between stops.
bundle_walk <- function(D, stops, pace = "normal") {
  p <- PACES[[pace]]
  ord <- stops[1]; left <- stops[-1]; walk <- 0
  while (length(left)) {
    d <- D$W[ord[length(ord)], left]       # places come first in D$nodes, so place index = node index
    k <- which.min(d)
    walk <- walk + d[k]; ord <- c(ord, left[k]); left <- left[-k]
  }
  list(order = ord, minutes = sum(D$places$stay_min[stops]) * p$stay + walk * p$walk)
}

bundle_fits <- function(D, stops, part, pace = "normal") fit_check(D, stops, part, pace)$status == "ok"

# Share by which the streets near these stops are quieter at `hour` than at their busiest hour
# (8-22 h) on that weekday; NA if none of the stops has a sensor nearby.
quiet_share <- function(D, stops, day, hour) {
  s <- stops[!is.na(D$places$sensor_id[stops])]
  if (length(s) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  total <- function(h) sum(D$busy[s, day, h + 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  peak <- max(vapply(8:22, total, numeric(1)))
  if (peak <= 0) NA_real_ else 1 - total(hour) / peak
}
part_hour <- function(part) floor((part$t0 + part$t1) / 2 / 60)

# Bundles (row numbers of B) for this part that fit, best first; `theme` NULL = any kind. `taken`:
# bundle ids already used in other parts; `used`: places already planned; `room`: places the free time
# can still take (at most MAX_STOPS in all).
suggest_bundles <- function(D, B, part, theme = NULL, taken = character(), pace = "normal", room = MAX_STOPS,
                            used = integer()) {
  cand <- which(!(B$id %in% taken) & lengths(B$core) <= room &
                !vapply(B$core, function(s) any(s %in% used), logical(1)))
  if (!is.null(theme)) cand <- cand[vapply(B$themes[cand], function(t) theme %in% t, logical(1))]
  cand <- cand[vapply(cand, function(k) bundle_fits(D, B$core[[k]], bundle_part(B, k, part), pace), logical(1))]
  if (length(cand) == 0) return(integer())
  q <- vapply(cand, function(k) quiet_share(D, B$core[[k]], part$day, part_hour(bundle_part(B, k, part))), numeric(1))
  score <- 3 * (!is.na(B$official_walk[cand])) +
           2 * (B$best_slot[cand] == part$part) +
           0.5 * (!is.null(theme) & vapply(cand, function(k) B$themes[[k]][1] %in% theme, logical(1))) +
           ifelse(is.na(q), 0.3, q)
  cand[order(-score)]
}

bundle_reason <- function(D, B, k, part) {
  part <- bundle_part(B, k, part)
  h <- part_hour(part)
  q <- quiet_share(D, B$core[[k]], part$day, h)
  crowd <- if (is.na(q)) "" else if (q >= 0.05)
    sprintf(tr(" Around %s on a %s the streets by these stops are %d%% quieter than at their busiest hour."),
            fmt_time(h * 60), day_name(part$day, "full"), round(100 * q))
  else sprintf(tr(" Around %s is about the busiest hour on these streets on a %s."), fmt_time(h * 60),
               day_name(part$day, "full"))
  paste0(bundle_idea(B, k), crowd)
}

name: R/calendar.R
content:
# Free time from a calendar file.
# Visitors export their calendar as .ics (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar and Outlook all can).
# The file is read in this R session only; nothing is uploaded anywhere.

TZ <- "Australia/Melbourne"

# Minimal iCalendar reader: VEVENT start, end, summary and location.
parse_ics <- function(path) {
  raw <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  raw <- sub("\r$", "", raw)
  # unfold continuation lines (RFC 5545: a line starting with a space or tab continues the previous one)
  grp <- cumsum(!grepl("^[ \t]", raw))
  lines <- unname(tapply(sub("^[ \t]", "", raw), grp, paste, collapse = ""))
  starts <- which(lines == "BEGIN:VEVENT"); ends <- which(lines == "END:VEVENT")
  if (length(starts) == 0) return(empty_events())
  unescape <- function(v) gsub("\\\\([,;\\\\])", "\\1", gsub("\\\\[nN]", " ", v))
  ev <- lapply(seq_along(starts), function(k) {
    block <- lines[(starts[k] + 1):(ends[k] - 1)]
    key <- toupper(sub("[;:].*$", "", block))
    params <- ifelse(grepl("^[^:]*;", block), sub("^[^;]*;([^:]*):.*$", "\\1", block), "")
    value <- sub("^[^:]*:", "", block)
    get <- function(k) if (any(key == k)) list(value = value[key == k][1], params = params[key == k][1]) else NULL
    s <- get("DTSTART"); e <- get("DTEND")
    if (is.null(s)) return(NULL)
    st <- ics_time(s$value, s$params)
    en <- if (is.null(e)) st + ifelse(attr(st, "allday"), 86400, 3600) else ics_time(e$value, e$params)
    data.frame(start = as.POSIXct(st), end = as.POSIXct(en), allday = isTRUE(attr(st, "allday")),
               summary = unescape(if (is.null(get("SUMMARY"))) "" else get("SUMMARY")$value),
               location = unescape(if (is.null(get("LOCATION"))) "" else get("LOCATION")$value))
  })
  ev <- do.call(rbind, ev)
  if (is.null(ev)) return(empty_events())
  attr(ev$start, "tzone") <- TZ; attr(ev$end, "tzone") <- TZ
  ev[order(ev$start), ]
}

empty_events <- function() {
