  data.frame(start = as.POSIXct(character(), tz = TZ), end = as.POSIXct(character(), tz = TZ),
             allday = logical(), summary = character(), location = character())
}

# "20261104T090000", "20261103T220000Z" (UTC) or "20261104" with VALUE=DATE (all day).
ics_time <- function(v, params) {
  allday <- grepl("VALUE=DATE(;|$)", params) || nchar(v) == 8
  if (allday) {
    t <- as.POSIXct(paste0(v, "000000"), format = "%Y%m%d%H%M%S", tz = TZ)
  } else if (grepl("Z$", v)) {
    t <- as.POSIXct(sub("Z$", "", v), format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC")
  } else {
    tz <- sub("^.*TZID=([^;]*).*$", "\\1", params)
    if (!nzchar(tz) || tz == params || !(tz %in% OlsonNames())) tz <- TZ
    t <- as.POSIXct(v, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = tz)
  }
  attr(t, "tzone") <- TZ
  attr(t, "allday") <- allday
  t
}

# Match a calendar location ("Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, ...") to a start point or place.
match_location <- function(loc, D) {
  if (!nzchar(loc)) return(NA_character_)
  l <- tolower(loc)
  keys <- list(mcec = c("convention", "exhibition centre", "mcec"),
               southern_cross = c("southern cross", "skybus", "spencer st"),
               flinders_st_stn = c("flinders street station", "flinders st station"),
               melb_central_stn = c("melbourne central"),
               parliament_stn = c("parliament station"))
  for (id in names(keys)) if (any(vapply(keys[[id]], grepl, logical(1), x = l, fixed = TRUE))) return(id)
  hit <- which(vapply(tolower(D$places$name), function(n) grepl(n, l, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)))
  if (length(hit)) return(D$places$id[hit[1]])
  NA_character_
}

# Free windows on each date between day_start and day_end that are not covered by a timed event.
# base_t0 / base_start keep where and when the free time really starts; t0 / start can move later
# when the visitor takes a rest first (rest = minutes, spent at the place they are staying).
# Each window starts where the previous event was (or at the home base) and must end where the
# next event is (or back at the home base), with `buffer` minutes kept clear around events.
# start_auto / end_auto mark the ends that are the home base (no event, or one we could not place):
# those follow where the visitor sleeps that night once it is chosen (Where to stay, app.R).
free_windows <- function(ev, dates, D, home = "southern_cross", day_start = 8 * 60, day_end = 21 * 60,
                         min_len = 90, buffer = 15) {
  out <- list()
  for (d in as.character(dates)) {
    day0 <- as.POSIXct(paste(d, "00:00:00"), tz = TZ)
    e <- ev[!ev$allday & ev$end > day0 & ev$start < day0 + 86400, ]
    s <- pmax(0, as.numeric(difftime(e$start, day0, units = "mins")) - buffer)
    f <- pmin(1440, as.numeric(difftime(e$end, day0, units = "mins")) + buffer)
    cur <- day_start; prev_loc <- home; prev_auto <- TRUE
    ord <- order(s)
    for (k in c(ord, NA)) {
      nxt_s <- if (is.na(k)) day_end else s[k]
      m <- if (is.na(k)) NA else match_location(e$location[k], D)
      nxt_loc <- if (is.na(m)) home else m
      if (min(nxt_s, day_end) - cur >= min_len)
        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.frame(date = as.Date(d), t0 = cur, t1 = min(nxt_s, day_end),
                                             start = prev_loc, end = nxt_loc, source = "calendar",
                                             start_auto = prev_auto, end_auto = is.na(m))
      if (!is.na(k)) {
        cur <- max(cur, f[k])
        prev_loc <- nxt_loc; prev_auto <- is.na(m)
      }
      if (cur >= day_end) break
    }
  }
  if (length(out) == 0) return(empty_windows())
  w <- do.call(rbind, out)
  w$t0 <- ceiling(w$t0 / 15) * 15; w$t1 <- floor(w$t1 / 15) * 15     # tidy to quarter hours
  w <- w[w$t1 - w$t0 >= min_len, ]
  w$id <- sprintf("w%d", seq_len(nrow(w)))
  w$base_t0 <- w$t0; w$base_start <- w$start; w$rest <- 0
  w[, c("id", "date", "t0", "t1", "start", "end", "source", "base_t0", "base_start", "rest", "start_auto", "end_auto")]
}

empty_windows <- function() {
  data.frame(id = character(), date = as.Date(character()), t0 = numeric(), t1 = numeric(),
             start = character(), end = character(), source = character(),
             base_t0 = numeric(), base_start = character(), rest = numeric(),
             start_auto = logical(), end_auto = logical())
}

window_label <- function(w, short = FALSE) {
  day <- fmt_date(w$date, if (short) "%a %e %b" else "%A %e %B")
  sprintf("%s · %s–%s", gsub("  ", " ", day), fmt_time(w$t0), fmt_time(w$t1))
}

# Export the plan as an iCalendar file: one event per stop (Melbourne local time). plans: window id ->
# its plan (an option of plan_trip(), the same as the day pages and the PDF show). Returns the
# lines; write them with CRLF line ends.
plan_ics <- function(windows, plans, D) {
  esc <- function(v) gsub("\n", "\\\\n", gsub("([,;\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", v))
  stamp <- function(date, m) sprintf("%sT%02d%02d00", format(date, "%Y%m%d"), as.integer(m %/% 60), as.integer(round(m %% 60)))
  now <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", tz = "UTC")
  ev <- character()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(windows))) {
    w <- windows[k, ]
    opt <- plans[[w$id]]
    if (is.null(opt)) next
    for (j in seq_along(opt$order)) {
      i <- opt$order[j]
      t0 <- round(opt$start[j]); t1 <- round(opt$end[j])
      ev <- c(ev, "BEGIN:VEVENT",
              sprintf("UID:%s-%s-%s@melbourne-in-n-hours", format(w$date, "%Y%m%d"), w$id, D$places$id[i]),
              paste0("DTSTAMP:", now),
              paste0("DTSTART;TZID=Australia/Melbourne:", stamp(w$date, t0)),
              paste0("DTEND;TZID=Australia/Melbourne:", stamp(w$date, t1)),
              paste0("SUMMARY:", esc(sprintf("%d. %s", j, place_name(D, i)))),
              # LOCATION stays the English name: calendar apps look it up on their maps.
              paste0("LOCATION:", esc(paste(D$places$name[i], "Melbourne VIC", sep = ", "))),
              sprintf("GEO:%.6f;%.6f", D$places$lat[i], D$places$lon[i]),
              paste0("DESCRIPTION:", esc(sprintf(tr("Stop %d of %d. About %d min walk from %s. Planned with Melbourne in N Hours."),
                                                 j, length(opt$order), round(opt$walk_in[j]),
                                                 if (j == 1) tr("where you set off") else tr("the previous stop")))),
              "END:VEVENT")
    }
  }
  c("BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID:-//GEOM90007 Group 24//Melbourne in N Hours//EN", "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "X-WR-TIMEZONE:Australia/Melbourne", ev, "END:VCALENDAR")
}

name: R/data.R
R/eat_stay.R
content:
# "Where to eat" and "Where to stay": places from the City of Melbourne's 2024 census
# (data/eateries.csv, data/stays.csv, tools/10_fetch_eat_stay.R), set against the visitor's own plan.
# The census has names, addresses and seats only (no hours, prices or reviews), so every name links
# to a map search where those can be checked.
#
# Walking times to these places are estimates: straight-line distance times the detour factor of our
# own walking network (median network / straight-line distance between the app's places, measured
# when the app starts), at the network's walking speed.

BRAND_BLUE <- "#0071E3"   # --brand in www/style.css: the visitor's own plan

# ---- the Overview menu (top bar) ----
# The first button of the top bar opens a menu of the three overview pages; it shows which one is
# open, and its chevron says that it opens (www/app.js toggleNavMenu, www/style.css .nav-menu).
NAV_PAGES <- c("overview", "eat", "stay")
NAV_ITEMS <- list(
  overview = list(label = "Trip plan",     sub = "Your days and what to do in them"),
  eat      = list(label = "Where to eat",  sub = "Near you at meal times"),
  stay     = list(label = "Where to stay", sub = "Close to everything in your trip"))

ES_ICON <- list(   # line icons for the Overview menu
  chevron = htmltools::HTML('<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>'),
  eat = htmltools::HTML('<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3v7a2 2 0 0 0 4 0V3M8 12v9M17 21V3c-2 1.5-3 4-3 7v3h3"/></svg>'),
  stay = htmltools::HTML('<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 19V6M3 14h18v5M21 14v-1a3 3 0 0 0-3-3h-7v4"/><circle cx="7" cy="11" r="1.6"/></svg>'))

nav_menu <- function(v) {
  cur <- if (v %in% NAV_PAGES) v else NA_character_
  shown <- if (is.na(cur)) "overview" else cur
  icons <- list(overview = ICON$grid, eat = ES_ICON$eat, stay = ES_ICON$stay)
  htmltools::div(class = "nav-menu",
    htmltools::tags$button(class = paste("nav-overview", if (!is.na(cur)) "active"), type = "button",
      `aria-haspopup` = "menu", `aria-expanded` = "false", title = tr("Trip plan, where to eat, where to stay"),
      onclick = "toggleNavMenu(event)",
      icons[[shown]],
      htmltools::span(class = "nav-label", htmltools::tags$small(tr("Overview")), htmltools::strong(tr(NAV_ITEMS[[shown]]$label))),
      htmltools::span(class = "nav-caret", ES_ICON$chevron)),
    htmltools::div(class = "nav-dropdown", role = "menu",
      lapply(NAV_PAGES, function(k) htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", role = "menuitem",
        class = if (identical(k, cur)) "current",
        onclick = paste0("closeNavMenu(); ", js_input("goto", k)),
        htmltools::span(class = "nav-item-icon", icons[[k]]),
        htmltools::span(class = "nav-item-text", htmltools::strong(tr(NAV_ITEMS[[k]]$label)),
                        htmltools::tags$small(tr(NAV_ITEMS[[k]]$sub)))))))
}

EAT_KINDS <- c(cafe = "Café or restaurant", takeaway = "Takeaway", pub = "Pub or bar", bakery = "Bakery café")
# Meal times: the window in which a meal can happen, and the time we look at inside it.
MEALS <- list(
  breakfast = list(label = "Breakfast or coffee", from = 7 * 60, to = 10 * 60 + 30, at = 8 * 60 + 30),
  lunch     = list(label = "Lunch",  from = 11 * 60 + 30, to = 14 * 60 + 30, at = 12 * 60 + 30),
  dinner    = list(label = "Dinner", from = 17 * 60 + 30, to = 21 * 60,      at = 18 * 60 + 30))
MEAL_MIN <- 45           # a meal is offered when this much of the free time falls inside its window
STAY_SHOW <- 12          # places to stay listed

load_eat_stay <- function(D, dir = "data") {
  eat <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "eateries.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stay <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "stays.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stay$id <- seq_len(nrow(stay))
  adr <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "addresses.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(no = "character"))
  adr$key <- tolower(adr$street); adr$row <- seq_len(nrow(adr))
  lon <- c(D$places$lon, D$starts$lon[match(setdiff(D$starts$id, D$places$id), D$starts$id)])
  lat <- c(D$places$lat, D$starts$lat[match(setdiff(D$starts$id, D$places$id), D$starts$id)])
  # Calibrate the estimate on our own network: pairs 300 m to 3 km apart in a straight line.
  n <- length(D$nodes)
  ij <- which(upper.tri(matrix(0, n, n)), arr.ind = TRUE)
  straight <- hav_m(lon[ij[, 1]], lat[ij[, 1]], lon[ij[, 2]], lat[ij[, 2]])
  net <- D$M[ij]; mins <- D$W[ij]
  ok <- straight > 300 & straight < 3000 & net > 0 & mins > 0
  list(eat = eat, stay = stay, adr = adr, streets = unique(adr$key[order(-nchar(adr$key))]), node_lon = setNames(lon, D$nodes), node_lat = setNames(lat, D$nodes),
       detour = median(net[ok] / straight[ok]), m_per_min = median(net[ok] / mins[ok]))
}

# Estimated walking minutes from one point to many.
est_walk <- function(E, lon, lat, lons, lats, pace = "normal") {
  hav_m(lon, lat, lons, lats) * E$detour / E$m_per_min * PACES[[pace]]$walk
}

gmaps_search <- function(name, address) {
  sprintf("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%s", utils::URLencode(paste(name, address, sep = ", "), reserved = TRUE))
}

seats_text <- function(i, o) {
  s <- sprintf(tr("%d seats"), as.integer(i + o))
  if (o > 0) paste0(s, tr(" · outdoor seats")) else s
}

# ---- day cards that fold (Where to eat, and "Your days" on the trip plan; www/app.js toggleFold) ----

fold_button <- function() {
  htmltools::tags$button(class = "fold-btn", type = "button", title = tr("Fold or unfold this day"),
                         onclick = "event.stopPropagation(); toggleFold(this)", ES_ICON$chevron)
}

# ---- where to eat ----

# How long a meal takes, by the kind of place (team assumptions): takeaway 20 min, a bakery café 30,
# a café, restaurant or pub about an hour; the must-try restaurants by price (a tasting menu is long).
EAT_MINUTES <- c(takeaway = 20, bakery = 30, cafe = 60, pub = 60)
PRICE_MINUTES <- c(`$` = 45, `$$` = 60, `$$$` = 90, `$$$$` = 150)
EAT_RADIUS <- 300        # metres around the middle of a walk to look for a place to eat
EAT_PER_WALK <- 3        # places to eat listed per walk

# The walks of a free time's plan: from where to where, when (the middle of the walk) and where its
# middle is (half way along the street line, or the straight line where none is stored). Without a
# plan, the walk from the start to the end point.
plan_walks <- function(D, E, w, p) {
  if (is.null(p)) {
    ids <- c(w$start, w$end); dep <- w$t0; arr <- w$t1
  } else {
    o <- p$opt
    ids <- c(w$start, D$places$id[o$order], w$end)
    dep <- c(w$t0, o$end); arr <- c(o$arrive, o$finish)
  }
  out <- lapply(seq_len(length(ids) - 1), function(k) {
    a <- ids[k]; b <- ids[k + 1]
    if (a == b) return(NULL)
    xy <- leg_coords(D, a, b)
    if (is.null(xy)) xy <- rbind(c(E$node_lon[[a]], E$node_lat[[a]]), c(E$node_lon[[b]], E$node_lat[[b]]))
    seg <- hav_m(xy[-nrow(xy), 1], xy[-nrow(xy), 2], xy[-1, 1], xy[-1, 2])
    cum <- c(0, cumsum(seg)); half <- cum[length(cum)] / 2
    j <- max(1, min(length(seg), findInterval(half, cum)))
    f <- if (seg[j] > 0) (half - cum[j]) / seg[j] else 0
    data.frame(from = a, to = b, t = (dep[k] + arr[k]) / 2,
               lon = xy[j, 1] + f * (xy[j + 1, 1] - xy[j, 1]), lat = xy[j, 2] + f * (xy[j + 1, 2] - xy[j, 2]))
  })
  do.call(rbind, c(Filter(Negate(is.null), out), list(data.frame(from = character(), to = character(), t = numeric(),
                                                                 lon = numeric(), lat = numeric()))))
}

# For each free time, the meals that fall inside it (at the visitor's time for it, else the usual one)
# and where to look for a place to eat: you eat on the way, so the two walks whose middle is nearest
# that time (e.g. the walk into the stop you are at and the walk out of it). Without any walk, the
# start point itself.
meal_spots <- function(D, E, ws, plans, times = list()) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(ws))) {
    w <- ws[k, ]
    walks <- plan_walks(D, E, w, plans[[w$id]])
    for (m in names(MEALS)) {
      M <- MEALS[[m]]
      if (min(w$t1, M$to) - max(w$t0, M$from) < MEAL_MIN) next
      key <- paste(w$id, m, sep = "|")
      t <- if (is.null(times[[key]])) M$at else times[[key]]
      t <- min(max(t, w$t0), w$t1)
      near <- if (nrow(walks)) walks[head(order(abs(walks$t - t)), 2), ] else walks
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- list(key = key, wid = w$id, date = w$date, meal = m, t = t,
                                     earliest = w$t0, latest = w$t1, walks = near[order(near$t), ], node = w$start)
    }
  }
  out
}

# When the meal starts: a quarter hour from an hour before the meal's usual window to its end,
# inside the free time.
meal_time_ui <- function(s) {
  M <- MEALS[[s$meal]]
  first <- ceiling(max(s$earliest, M$from - 60) / 15) * 15
  last <- min(s$latest, M$to)
  opts <- sort(unique(c(if (first <= last) seq(first, last, by = 15), s$t)))
  htmltools::span(class = "es-time", onclick = "event.stopPropagation()",
    htmltools::tags$select(`aria-label` = tr("When you eat"),
      onchange = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('meal_time', {key: '%s', t: +this.value}, {priority: 'event'})", s$key),
      lapply(opts, function(o) htmltools::tags$option(value = o, selected = if (o == s$t) NA, fmt_time(o)))))
}

# Places to eat within EAT_RADIUS of a point (the middle of a walk), after the filters, with the
# detour: walking there and back to the route. Ordered by detour, then by seats.
eat_near_point <- function(E, lon, lat, kinds, outdoor, group, pace, n = EAT_PER_WALK) {
  e <- E$eat
  e <- e[e$kind %in% kinds & (!outdoor | e$seats_out > 0) & (!group | e$seats_in + e$seats_out >= 40), ]
  if (nrow(e) == 0) return(e)
  d <- hav_m(lon, lat, e$lon, e$lat)
  e <- e[d <= EAT_RADIUS, ]
  if (nrow(e) == 0) return(e)
  e$detour <- 2 * est_walk(E, lon, lat, e$lon, e$lat, pace)
  head(e[order(round(e$detour), -(e$seats_in + e$seats_out)), ], n)
}

eat_row <- function(e, r) {
  htmltools::div(class = "es-row",
    htmltools::tags$a(href = gmaps_search(e$name[r], e$address[r]), target = "_blank", rel = "noopener",
                      onclick = "event.stopPropagation()", e$name[r]),
    htmltools::span(class = paste("es-kind", e$kind[r]), tr(EAT_KINDS[[e$kind[r]]])),
    htmltools::span(class = "es-walk", if (e$detour[r] < 1.5) tr("on the way") else sprintf(tr("+%d min"), as.integer(round(e$detour[r])))),
    htmltools::tags$small(paste(seats_text(e$seats_in[r], e$seats_out[r]),
                                sprintf(tr("about %s to eat"), fmt_dur(EAT_MINUTES[[e$kind[r]]])), sep = " · ")))
}

eat_list_ui <- function(D, E, spots, focus, kinds, outdoor, group, pace) {
  if (length(spots) == 0)
    return(htmltools::div(class = "es-empty", tr("None of your free times covers breakfast, lunch or dinner. Add a longer free time in Trip settings.")))
  node_nm <- function(id) if (id %in% D$places$id) place_name(D, match(id, D$places$id)) else start_name(D, id)
  sdate <- as.Date(vapply(spots, function(s) format(s$date), ""))
  lapply(sort(unique(sdate)), function(d) {
    ss <- spots[sdate == d]
    htmltools::tags$section(class = "es-day foldable", `data-fold` = paste0("eat|", format(d)),
      htmltools::div(class = "fold-head", onclick = "toggleFold(this)",
        htmltools::h3(fmt_date(d, "%A %e %B")),
        htmltools::span(class = "fold-sum", paste(vapply(ss, function(s) sprintf("%s %s", tr(MEALS[[s$meal]]$label), fmt_time(s$t)), ""),
                                                  collapse = " · ")),
        fold_button()),
      htmltools::div(class = "fold-body", lapply(ss, function(s) {
        groups <- if (nrow(s$walks)) lapply(seq_len(nrow(s$walks)), function(j) {
          wk <- s$walks[j, ]
          e <- eat_near_point(E, wk$lon, wk$lat, kinds, outdoor, group, pace)
          htmltools::div(class = "es-walkgroup",
            htmltools::tags$small(class = "es-walkhead",
              sprintf(tr("On the way from %s to %s, around %s"), node_nm(wk$from), node_nm(wk$to), fmt_time(wk$t))),
            if (nrow(e) == 0) htmltools::p(class = "es-none", sprintf(tr("Nothing that matches within %d m of this walk."), EAT_RADIUS))
            else lapply(seq_len(nrow(e)), function(r) eat_row(e, r)))
        }) else {
          e <- eat_near_point(E, E$node_lon[[s$node]], E$node_lat[[s$node]], kinds, outdoor, group, pace)
          list(htmltools::div(class = "es-walkgroup",
            htmltools::tags$small(class = "es-walkhead", sprintf(tr("Near %s"), node_nm(s$node))),
            if (nrow(e) == 0) htmltools::p(class = "es-none", sprintf(tr("Nothing that matches within %d m."), EAT_RADIUS))
            else lapply(seq_len(nrow(e)), function(r) eat_row(e, r))))
        }
        htmltools::div(class = paste("es-meal", if (identical(focus, s$key)) "focus"),
          onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('eat_focus', '%s', {priority: 'event'})", s$key),
          htmltools::div(class = "es-meal-head",
            htmltools::div(class = "es-meal-title", htmltools::strong(tr(MEALS[[s$meal]]$label)), meal_time_ui(s))),
          groups)
      })))
  })
}

# ---- where to stay ----

# The points of the trip a place to stay should be close to: every planned place, and where each
# free time starts and ends (not the ends that are "where you stay" themselves).
trip_points <- function(D, ws, day_sel) {
  unique(c(unlist(day_sel, use.names = FALSE), ws$base_start[!ws$start_auto], ws$end[!ws$end_auto]))
}

# A place to stay becomes a start / end point like the stations: estimated walks to every other point
# (straight line x the network's detour, at its speed) and no stored street line (maps draw it straight).
# id is made from the coordinates (and `key`), so the same place is added once. A booked meal is
# added the same way with prefix "meal" (one point per meal, named after it).
add_stay_node <- function(D, E, name, lon, lat, prefix = "stay", key = "", note = "where you stay") {
  id <- sprintf("%s_%d_%d%s", prefix, round(lon * 1e5), round(-lat * 1e5), key)
  if (id %in% D$nodes) return(list(D = D, E = E, id = id))
  m <- hav_m(lon, lat, E$node_lon[D$nodes], E$node_lat[D$nodes]) * E$detour
  nodes <- c(D$nodes, id)
  D$W <- rbind(cbind(D$W, m / E$m_per_min), c(m / E$m_per_min, 0)); dimnames(D$W) <- list(nodes, nodes)
  D$M <- rbind(cbind(D$M, m), c(m, 0)); dimnames(D$M) <- list(nodes, nodes)
  D$nodes <- nodes
  D$starts <- rbind(D$starts, data.frame(id = id, name = name, lat = lat, lon = lon, note = note))
  E$node_lon <- c(E$node_lon, setNames(lon, id)); E$node_lat <- c(E$node_lat, setNames(lat, id))
  list(D = D, E = E, id = id)
}

# The nights of the trip, one row per night (the date it starts): from the night before the first
# free day to the night of the last one. That last night is optional (the visitor may fly home
# that day), so it starts switched off. Choices already made are kept by date when the free times
# change. kind: "none", "hotel" (from the list), "address" (typed) or "pin" (clicked on the map).
nights_for <- function(ws, old = NULL) {
  if (nrow(ws) == 0) return(NULL)
  d <- seq(min(ws$date) - 1, max(ws$date), by = 1)
  n <- data.frame(date = d, optional = d == max(d), on = d != max(d), kind = "none", name = "", address = "",
                  lon = NA_real_, lat = NA_real_, node = NA_character_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(old)) {
    m <- match(n$date, old$date)
    f <- c("on", "kind", "name", "address", "lon", "lat", "node")
    n[!is.na(m), f] <- old[m[!is.na(m)], f]
    # a night that was the optional last one and now has a day after it is a night you stay
    was_last <- !is.na(m) & old$optional[pmax(1, m)] & !n$optional
    n$on[was_last] <- TRUE
  }
  n
}

# Where a night's place to stay matters: where that day's last free time ends (walking back in the
# evening) and where the next day's first one starts (walking out in the morning). When that end is
# "where you stay" itself, the last (first) planned stop of that free time counts instead.
night_points <- function(D, ws, plans, d) {
  ev <- ws[ws$date == d, ]; mo <- ws[ws$date == d + 1, ]
  stop_at <- function(w, last) {
    p <- plans[[w$id]]
    if (is.null(p)) NA else D$places$id[if (last) tail(p$opt$order, 1) else p$opt$order[1]]
  }
  evening <- if (nrow(ev)) { w <- ev[which.max(ev$t1), ]; if (isTRUE(w$end_auto)) stop_at(w, TRUE) else w$end } else NA
  morning <- if (nrow(mo)) { w <- mo[which.min(mo$t0), ]; if (isTRUE(w$start_auto)) stop_at(w, FALSE) else w$base_start } else NA
  c(evening = evening, morning = morning)
}

night_label <- function(d) sprintf("%s → %s", fmt_date(d, "%a %e %b"), fmt_date(d + 1, "%a %e %b"))

# A typed address -> a point, from the City of Melbourne's street addresses (data/addresses.csv), no
# online lookup. Understands "45 William St", "12/45 William Street, Melbourne VIC 3000" (flat 12 at
# number 45) and the usual short street types. Returns NULL when the street is not in the list;
# `exact` is FALSE when the number was not found and the nearest number on that street is used.
ADDR_ABBR <- c(st = "street", rd = "road", ave = "avenue", av = "avenue", pde = "parade", ln = "lane", pl = "place",
               tce = "terrace", cres = "crescent", cr = "crescent", dr = "drive", blvd = "boulevard", bvd = "boulevard",
               hwy = "highway", sq = "square", ct = "court", esp = "esplanade", prom = "promenade", cct = "circuit")
find_address <- function(E, text) {
  x <- tolower(gsub("[,.;]", " ", text))
  x <- gsub("\\b(vic|victoria|australia)\\b", " ", x)
  w <- strsplit(trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x)), " ")[[1]]
  if (!length(w)) return(NULL)
  w <- ifelse(w %in% names(ADDR_ABBR), ADDR_ABBR[w], w)
  padded <- paste0(" ", paste(w[!grepl("[0-9]", w)], collapse = " "), " ")
  hit <- NA
  for (st in E$streets) if (grepl(paste0(" ", st, " "), padded, fixed = TRUE)) { hit <- st; break }
  if (is.na(hit)) return(NULL)
  # the house number is the last number before the street name ("Level 55, 525 Collins St" is 525;
  # "7/200 Bourke St" and "Basement/141 Flinders Ln" are 200 and 141)
  sw <- strsplit(hit, " ")[[1]]; at <- NA
  for (i in seq_len(max(0, length(w) - length(sw) + 1))) if (all(w[i:(i + length(sw) - 1)] == sw)) { at <- i; break }
  before <- if (!is.na(at) && at > 1) w[seq_len(at - 1)] else character()
  num <- rev(before[grepl("[0-9]", before)])[1]
  if (!is.na(num)) num <- sub("^.*/", "", num)
  a <- E$adr[E$adr$key == hit, ]
  sbs <- unique(tolower(a$suburb))
  sb <- sbs[vapply(sbs, function(s) grepl(paste0(" ", s, " "), padded, fixed = TRUE), logical(1))]
  if (length(sb)) a <- a[tolower(a$suburb) == sb[which.max(nchar(sb))], ]
  exact <- FALSE
  if (!is.na(num)) {
    no <- sub("-.*$", "", sub("^.*/", "", num))
    if (any(tolower(a$no) == no)) { a <- a[tolower(a$no) == no, ][1, ]; exact <- TRUE }
    else {
      nn <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("[a-z]+$", "", tolower(a$no))))
      a <- a[which.min(abs(nn - suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("[a-z]+$", "", no))))), ]
    }
  } else a <- a[ceiling(nrow(a) / 2), ]
  if (nrow(a) == 0) return(NULL)
  list(name = sprintf("%s %s", a$no, a$street), address = sprintf("%s %s, %s", a$no, a$street, a$suburb),
       lon = a$lon, lat = a$lat, exact = exact, id = as.character(a$row))
}

# One search box for where you sleep: places to stay by name (every typed word in the name or
# address) and City of Melbourne street addresses ("45 William St"; a street without a number gives
# the street, to be made exact with the number). Items: kind ("hotel", "address", "street"), id,
# label, sub (the line under it).
search_stays <- function(E, q, n_hotel = 5, n_addr = 5) {
  ql <- tolower(trimws(gsub("[,.;]", " ", q)))
  if (nchar(ql) < 2) return(list())
  words <- strsplit(ql, "\\s+")[[1]]
  # a word matches the start of a word in the name or address; a number only the same number
  # (so "300" does not find the postcode 3000)
  tokens <- strsplit(tolower(paste(E$stay$name, E$stay$address)), "[^a-z0-9']+")
  has <- function(w) vapply(tokens, function(t) if (grepl("^[0-9]", w)) w %in% t else any(startsWith(t, w)), logical(1))
  h <- E$stay[Reduce(`&`, lapply(words, has)), ]
  h <- head(h[order(!startsWith(tolower(h$name), ql), h$name), ], n_hotel)
  hotels <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(h)), function(i)
    list(kind = "hotel", id = as.character(h$id[i]), label = h$name[i], sub = h$address[i]))
  addrs <- list()
  a <- find_address(E, q)
  if (!is.null(a) && a$exact) addrs <- list(list(kind = "address", id = a$id, label = a$name, sub = a$address))
  else {
    num <- words[grepl("^[0-9]", words)][1]
    rest <- words[!grepl("^[0-9]", words)]
    rest <- ifelse(rest %in% names(ADDR_ABBR), ADDR_ABBR[rest], rest)
    txt <- paste(rest, collapse = " ")
    if (nchar(txt) >= 2) {
      st <- E$streets[startsWith(E$streets, txt)]
      if (!length(st)) st <- E$streets[grepl(txt, E$streets, fixed = TRUE)]
      rows <- E$adr[E$adr$key %in% head(st, n_addr), ]
      if (!is.na(num)) {
        no <- sub("-.*$", "", sub("^.*/", "", num))
        ex <- which(tolower(rows$no) == no)
        addrs <- lapply(head(ex, n_addr), function(i) list(kind = "address", id = as.character(rows$row[i]),
          label = sprintf("%s %s", rows$no[i], rows$street[i]), sub = rows$suburb[i]))
      }
      if (!length(addrs)) {
        u <- rows[!duplicated(rows[, c("street", "suburb")]), ]
        addrs <- lapply(seq_len(min(n_addr, nrow(u))), function(i) list(kind = "street", id = paste(u$key[i], u$suburb[i], sep = "|"),
          label = u$street[i], sub = sprintf(tr("%s · add the house number for the exact spot"), u$suburb[i])))
      }
    }
  }
  c(hotels, addrs)
}

# What a picked search item means for a night: list(kind, name, address, lon, lat).
stay_pick_vals <- function(E, kind, id) {
  if (kind == "hotel") {
    s <- E$stay[E$stay$id == as.integer(id), ]
    return(list(kind = "hotel", name = s$name, address = s$address, lon = s$lon, lat = s$lat))
  }
  a <- if (kind == "address") E$adr[as.integer(id), ] else {
    k <- strsplit(id, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    r <- E$adr[E$adr$key == k[1] & E$adr$suburb == k[2], ]
    r[ceiling(nrow(r) / 2), ]           # a street without a number: its middle address
  }
  list(kind = "address", name = sprintf("%s %s", a$no, a$street), address = sprintf("%s %s, %s", a$no, a$street, a$suburb),
       lon = a$lon, lat = a$lat)
}

# The search box (www/app.js staySearch): `night` is a date, or "all" for every night.
stay_search_box <- function(night, placeholder = tr("Hotel name or address, e.g. Novotel or 45 William St")) {
  htmltools::div(class = "stay-search", `data-night` = night, onclick = "event.stopPropagation()",
    htmltools::tags$input(type = "search", autocomplete = "off", placeholder = placeholder,
                          oninput = "staySearch(this)", onkeydown = "staySearchKey(event, this)"),
    htmltools::div(class = "stay-suggest"))
}

# The street address nearest to a clicked point, if one is within 80 m.
near_address <- function(E, lon, lat) {
  d <- hav_m(lon, lat, E$adr$lon, E$adr$lat)
  k <- which.min(d)
  if (length(k) && d[k] <= 80) sprintf(tr("near %s %s, %s"), E$adr$no[k], E$adr$street[k], E$adr$suburb[k]) else ""
}

nights_ui <- function(D, E, nights, ws, plans, active, pinning, pace) {
  if (is.null(nights)) return(NULL)
  node_nm <- function(id) if (id %in% D$places$id) place_name(D, match(id, D$places$id)) else start_name(D, id)
  walk_to <- function(n, id) as.integer(round(est_walk(E, n$lon, n$lat, E$node_lon[[id]], E$node_lat[[id]], pace)))
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(nights)), function(i) {
    n <- nights[i, ]; key <- format(n$date); on <- n$on; is_active <- identical(active, key)
    pts <- night_points(D, ws, plans, n$date)
    walks <- if (on && n$kind != "none") c(
      if (!is.na(pts[["evening"]])) sprintf(tr("%d min back from %s"), walk_to(n, pts[["evening"]]), node_nm(pts[["evening"]])),
      if (!is.na(pts[["morning"]])) sprintf(tr("%d min to %s the next morning"), walk_to(n, pts[["morning"]]), node_nm(pts[["morning"]])))
    htmltools::div(class = paste("night", if (is_active) "active", if (!on) "off"),
      onclick = if (on) sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('night_pick', '%s', {priority: 'event'})", key),
      htmltools::div(class = "night-date",
        htmltools::strong(night_label(n$date)),
        if (n$optional) htmltools::tags$label(class = "night-opt", onclick = "event.stopPropagation()",
          htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", checked = if (on) NA,
            onchange = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('night_on', {date: '%s', on: this.checked}, {priority: 'event'})", key)),
          tr("I stay this night too"))),
      if (!on) htmltools::div(class = "night-choice muted", tr("Not staying this night: maybe you fly home that day."))
      else htmltools::div(class = "night-choice",
        if (n$kind == "none") htmltools::span(class = "muted", tr("Not chosen yet"))
        else htmltools::tagList(htmltools::strong(n$name), htmltools::tags$small(n$address)),
        if (length(walks)) htmltools::tags$small(class = "night-walks", paste(walks, collapse = " · "))),
      if (on && is_active) htmltools::div(class = "night-actions", onclick = "event.stopPropagation()",
        stay_search_box(key),
        htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = paste("btn secondary", if (pinning) "on"),
          onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('night_pin', '%s', {priority: 'event'})", key),
          if (pinning) tr("Now click the map…") else tr("Not found? Click it on the map")),
        if (n$kind != "none") htmltools::tagList(
          htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn secondary",
            onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('night_all', '%s', {priority: 'event'})", key), tr("Same for every night")),
          htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn secondary",
            onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('night_clear', '%s', {priority: 'event'})", key), tr("Clear")))))
  })
  chosen <- sum(nights$on & nights$kind != "none")
  htmltools::tags$section(class = "nights",
    htmltools::div(class = "nights-head",
      htmltools::h2(tr("Your nights")),
      htmltools::span(sprintf(tr("%d of %d nights chosen. Click a night, then search for a hotel or an address."),
                              chosen, sum(nights$on)))),
    rows)
}

# Average and longest estimated walk from each place to stay to some of the trip's points.
stay_rank <- function(E, points, pace) {
  s <- E$stay
  if (length(points) == 0) return(NULL)
  w <- vapply(points, function(p) est_walk(E, E$node_lon[[p]], E$node_lat[[p]], s$lon, s$lat, pace), numeric(nrow(s)))
  w <- matrix(w, nrow(s))
  s$avg <- rowMeans(w); s$max <- apply(w, 1, max); s$far <- points[apply(w, 1, which.max)]
  s[order(s$avg), ]
}

# Colour for "how close to the trip" (light = far, dark = close), slate so it stays apart from the
# orange of street busyness and the blue of the plan.
STAY_COLS <- c("#CBD5E1", "#94A3B8", "#64748B", "#334155")
stay_col <- function(avg) STAY_COLS[findInterval(-avg, -c(Inf, 20, 15, 10))]

# ---- worth a trip for the food: restaurants the visitor saves as places of their days ----
# data/destination_restaurants.csv (tools/11_build_destination_restaurants.R): restaurants in the CBD
# that curated lists rate highly, with our own one-line notes. The search also finds any place in the
# 2024 seating census. A saved restaurant becomes a place of this session's D (category
# FOOD_CATEGORY): every day page lists it and can add it, open at lunch and / or dinner time. It is
# not one of the trip plan's places (the home page lists CATEGORY_ORDER only).

FOOD_CATEGORY <- "Restaurants you saved"
LUNCH_HOURS <- "11:30-15:00"; DINNER_HOURS <- "17:30-22:00"; ALL_DAY_HOURS <- "11:30-22:00"
UNKNOWN_HOURS <- "08:00-21:00"   # census places: hours not known (shown as such)

load_destinations <- function(dir = "data") {
  f <- file.path(dir, "destination_restaurants.csv")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  d <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
  d$rid <- seq_len(nrow(d))
  d
}

serves <- function(d, meal) {   # "yes", "some days" or "no" for lunch / dinner
  v <- d[[meal]]
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) "unknown" else v
}

# What a restaurant needs to be a place: id, name, where, how long, its hours (one span a day: lunch,
# dinner, or lunch to dinner; the census has no hours) and a note for its card.
food_place <- function(DEST, E, src, id) {
  if (src == "dest") {
    r <- DEST[DEST$rid == as.integer(id), ]
    l <- serves(r, "lunch") != "no"; dn <- serves(r, "dinner") != "no"
    hours <- if (l && dn) ALL_DAY_HOURS else if (l) LUNCH_HOURS else DINNER_HOURS
    some <- "some days" %in% c(serves(r, "lunch"), serves(r, "dinner"))
    list(id = sprintf("food_d%d", r$rid), name = r$name, lon = r$lon, lat = r$lat,
         stay = if (!is.na(r$price) && r$price %in% names(PRICE_MINUTES)) PRICE_MINUTES[[r$price]] else 60,
         hours = hours, url = if (!is.na(r$website)) r$website else gmaps_search(r$name, r$address),
         note = paste(c(r$why, if (some) "Not open every day: check its days on its website."), collapse = " "))
  } else {
    e <- E$eat[as.integer(id), ]
    list(id = sprintf("food_c%s", id), name = e$name, lon = e$lon, lat = e$lat, stay = EAT_MINUTES[[e$kind]],
         hours = UNKNOWN_HOURS, url = gmaps_search(e$name, e$address),
         note = sprintf("%s, %s. Opening hours are not known: check before you go.", EAT_KINDS[[e$kind]], e$address))
  }
}

# Add a restaurant as a place of D. Places stay first in D$nodes and keep their order (bundle_walk
# uses a place's row as its node), so the new one goes after the last place; the start points follow.
# Its walks to every other point are estimates (straight line x the network's detour, drawn straight).
add_food_place <- function(D, E, f) {
  if (f$id %in% D$places$id) return(list(D = D, E = E))
  p <- D$places[1, ]; p[1, ] <- NA
  p$id <- f$id; p$name <- f$name; p$category <- FOOD_CATEGORY; p$lat <- f$lat; p$lon <- f$lon
  p$setting <- "indoor"; p$entry <- "paid"; p$stay_min <- f$stay; p$official_url <- f$url; p$notes <- f$note
  for (d in DAYS) p[[d]] <- f$hours
  D$places <- rbind(D$places, p)
  h <- parse_hours(f$hours)
  D$open <- rbind(D$open, rep(h[1], 7)); D$close <- rbind(D$close, rep(h[2], 7))
  D$last_entry <- c(D$last_entry, NA_real_)
  b <- array(NA_real_, dim(D$busy) + c(1, 0, 0)); b[seq_len(dim(D$busy)[1]), , ] <- D$busy; D$busy <- b
  old <- D$nodes
  nodes <- c(D$places$id, setdiff(old, D$places$id))
  lon <- c(E$node_lon[old], setNames(f$lon, f$id)); lat <- c(E$node_lat[old], setNames(f$lat, f$id))
  m <- hav_m(f$lon, f$lat, lon[old], lat[old]) * E$detour
  W <- M <- matrix(0, length(nodes), length(nodes), dimnames = list(nodes, nodes))
  W[old, old] <- D$W[old, old]; M[old, old] <- D$M[old, old]
  W[f$id, old] <- W[old, f$id] <- m / E$m_per_min
  M[f$id, old] <- M[old, f$id] <- m
  D$W <- W; D$M <- M; D$nodes <- nodes
  E$node_lon <- lon[nodes]; E$node_lat <- lat[nodes]
  list(D = D, E = E)
}

# The card's list: the must-try restaurants (filtered in the browser as you type, www/app.js
# mustSearch) and, under it, other places to eat the search found in the census. `saved`: place ids.
food_item <- function(id, src, name, sub, why = NULL, dish = NULL, url = NULL, saved = FALSE, hay = "") {
  htmltools::div(class = paste("must-item", if (saved) "saved"), `data-hay` = hay,
    onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('food_focus', {src: '%s', id: '%s'}, {priority: 'event'})", src, id),
    htmltools::div(class = "must-main",
      htmltools::strong(name), htmltools::tags$small(sub),
      if (!is.null(why)) htmltools::span(class = "must-why", why),
      if (!is.null(dish)) htmltools::tags$small(class = "must-dish", sprintf(tr("Known for: %s"), dish))),
    htmltools::div(class = "must-actions", onclick = "event.stopPropagation()",
      if (!is.null(url)) htmltools::tags$a(href = url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", class = "btn secondary", tr("Website ↗")),
      if (saved) htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn secondary",
        onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('food_unsave', '%s', {priority: 'event'})", sprintf("food_%s%s", if (src == "dest") "d" else "c", id)),
        tr("Saved ✓ · remove"))
      else htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn secondary",
        onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('food_save', {src: '%s', id: '%s'}, {priority: 'event'})", src, id), tr("Save to my places")),
      htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn primary",
        onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('food_day', {src: '%s', id: '%s'}, {priority: 'event'})", src, id), tr("Add to a day…"))))
}

destinations_ui <- function(d, saved) {
  if (is.null(d)) return(NULL)
  price <- function(p) if (is.na(p) || p == "unknown") NULL else p
  when <- function(r) paste(c(if (serves(r, "lunch") != "no") tr("Lunch"), if (serves(r, "dinner") != "no") tr("Dinner")), collapse = " · ")
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(class = "must-list", lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) {
      r <- d[i, ]
      food_item(r$rid, "dest", r$name, paste(c(r$cuisine, price(r$price), when(r)), collapse = " · "), why = r$why,
                dish = if (!is.na(r$dish) && r$dish != "unknown") r$dish,
                url = if (!is.na(r$website) && grepl("^https?://", r$website)) r$website,
                saved = sprintf("food_d%d", r$rid) %in% saved, hay = tolower(paste(r$name, r$cuisine, r$dish, r$why)))
    })),
    htmltools::p(class = "es-none must-none", style = "display:none", tr("None of the recommended restaurants matches.")))
}

# Other places to eat (the census) whose name has every typed word, not among the recommended ones.
search_census_food <- function(E, d, q, n = 8) {
  words <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(q)), "\\s+")[[1]]
  words <- words[nchar(words) >= 2]
  if (!length(words)) return(E$eat[0, ])
  hay <- tolower(E$eat$name)
  hit <- which(Reduce(`&`, lapply(words, function(w) grepl(w, hay, fixed = TRUE))))
  if (!is.null(d)) hit <- hit[!(gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", hay[hit]) %in% gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", tolower(d$name)))]
  e <- E$eat[head(hit, n), ]
  e$row <- head(hit, n)
  e
}

name: R/effort.R
content:
# "About how long, how tiring": the time and the steps on foot of one place, a walk or a whole plan.
#
# Time = the suggested stay at each place (stay_min, a team assumption, scaled by the pace setting)
# plus the walks between the stops (Vicmap network).
# Effort = steps on foot: the walks between the stops plus walking inside each place. Inside a place
# we assume an on-foot pace by the kind of visit (team assumptions): strolling outdoors in a park or
# along the river 3 km/h, browsing lanes, shops and markets 2 km/h, looking at exhibits and
# buildings 1.5 km/h. Steps = km x 1,300 (a stride of about 0.77 m).
# Levels are set against the familiar 10,000 steps a day: one place under 1,500 steps is easy and
# 3,000 or more is tiring; an outing (a walk or a free time) under 4,000 is easy and 8,000 or more
# is tiring -- for someone who exercises now and then. How tiring a walk feels depends on what the
# visitor is used to, so Trip settings asks how often they exercise and the cut points are scaled by
# their likely steps a day against 7,500 (bands of Tudor-Locke & Bassett 2004, Sports Medicine 34(1):
# under 5,000 "sedentary / low active", 7,500-9,999 "somewhat active", 10,000+ "active"). The
# mapping from the answer to a band is a team assumption.

STEPS_PER_KM <- 1300
EFFORT_LABELS <- c("Easy", "Medium", "Tiring")
EFFORT_CUTS <- list(place = c(1500, 3000), outing = c(4000, 8000))

inside_kmh <- function(places) {
  stroll <- places$category == "Parks & gardens" |
            (places$category == "Views & attractions" & places$setting == "outdoor")
  ifelse(stroll, 3, ifelse(places$category %in% c("Laneways & shopping", "Markets & food"), 2, 1.5))
}

# Metres on foot inside each place during its stay.
inside_m <- function(D, i, pace = "normal") {
  D$places$stay_min[i] * PACES[[pace]]$stay / 60 * inside_kmh(D$places[i, , drop = FALSE]) * 1000
}

# Minutes and steps of visiting `stops` in this order, with the walks between them; `from` / `to`
# (node ids) add the walk from a start point and back to an end point.
outing_effort <- function(D, stops, pace = "normal", from = NULL, to = NULL) {
  ids <- c(from, D$places$id[stops], to)
  k <- match(ids, D$nodes)
  legs <- if (length(k) > 1) cbind(k[-length(k)], k[-1]) else matrix(0L, 0, 2)
  walk_m <- sum(D$M[legs]); walk_min <- sum(D$W[legs]) * PACES[[pace]]$walk
  list(minutes = sum(D$places$stay_min[stops]) * PACES[[pace]]$stay + walk_min,
       walk_m = walk_m, steps = (walk_m + sum(inside_m(D, stops, pace))) / 1000 * STEPS_PER_KM)
}

FITNESS <- list(hardly = list(label = "Hardly ever",  scale = 5000 / 7500),
                sometimes = list(label = "Sometimes", scale = 1),
                often = list(label = "Often",          scale = 10000 / 7500))
# The answer in this session (input$fitness), read like the language in tr(): outputs that show an
# effort level are drawn again when it changes.
cur_fitness <- function() {
  dom <- shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
  f <- if (is.null(dom)) NULL else tryCatch(dom$input$fitness, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(f) && f %in% names(FITNESS)) f else "sometimes"
}
effort_cuts <- function(kind = "outing") round(EFFORT_CUTS[[kind]] * FITNESS[[cur_fitness()]]$scale, -2)

effort_level <- function(steps, kind = "outing") 1L + findInterval(steps, effort_cuts(kind))

# Round for display: to 100 steps for one place, to 500 for an outing. In the current language (tr()).
fmt_steps <- function(steps, kind = "outing") {
  r <- if (kind == "place") 100 else 500
  sprintf(tr("≈ %s steps"), format(max(r, round(steps / r) * r), big.mark = ","))
}

# Small three-bar meter with the level and the steps, e.g. "▮▮▯ Medium · ≈ 6,000 steps".
# `what`: what the steps include, for the tooltip (English; translated here, so callers may pass
# either the English text or an already translated one).
effort_tag <- function(steps, kind = "outing", steps_text = TRUE,
                       what = if (kind == "place") tr("walking about inside") else tr("walking between the stops and inside them")) {
  lv <- effort_level(steps, kind)
  htmltools::span(class = paste0("effort e", lv),
    title = sprintf(tr("%s on foot (%s). Easy under %s, tiring from %s steps."),
                    fmt_steps(steps, kind), tr(what), format(effort_cuts(kind)[1], big.mark = ","),
                    format(effort_cuts(kind)[2], big.mark = ",")),
    htmltools::tags$i(htmltools::tags$b(), htmltools::tags$b(), htmltools::tags$b()),
    tr(EFFORT_LABELS[lv]), if (steps_text) htmltools::tags$small(fmt_steps(steps, kind)))
}

# Sentence for the card above the overview: everything planned over the trip.
trip_total <- function(sums) {
  if (length(sums) == 0) return(NULL)
  m <- sum(vapply(sums, function(x) x$minutes, numeric(1))); st <- sum(vapply(sums, function(x) x$steps, numeric(1)))
  htmltools::span(class = "trip-total", sprintf(tr(" Planned so far: %s on the go, %s."), fmt_dur(m), fmt_steps(st)))
}

name: R/export.R
content:
# Export: the plan as a document to keep. It opens over the page ("Export" in the top bar, app.R and
# www/app.js); "Save as PDF" prints only the document, and the browser's own "Save as PDF" keeps
# its links clickable. No extra package or key is needed, so it also works in the online demo.
#
# First the trip at a glance (each free time, its places, time on the go, effort; each row links to
# its section) and where the numbers come from. Then one section per free time with something
# planned: a map of the walk, the stops with their times, and links to each place's website, to the
# place on Google Maps, and to walking directions (the whole walk from the map, one leg from "Directions").
#
# The map is an SVG drawn here: OpenStreetMap tiles (the same as the day map) under the street-following
# walking lines, the numbered stops coloured by street busyness on arrival, the start and the end.

EXPORT_MAP <- list(w = 688, h = 320, pad = 36)   # px; 688 px is 182 mm, an A4 page inside 14 mm margins
TILE_URL <- "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/%d/%d/%d.png"

node_lonlat <- function(D, id) {
  if (id %in% D$places$id) c(D$places$lon[D$places$id == id], D$places$lat[D$places$id == id])
  else c(D$starts$lon[D$starts$id == id], D$starts$lat[D$starts$id == id])
}

# Web Mercator pixel coordinates (of the whole world at zoom z, 256 px tiles) of lon / lat.
merc_px <- function(lon, lat, z) {
  n <- 256 * 2^z; s <- sin(lat * pi / 180)
  cbind((lon + 180) / 360 * n, (0.5 - log((1 + s) / (1 - s)) / (4 * pi)) * n)
}

# Google Maps links (Maps URLs: no key, they open the app on a phone). Points are c(lon, lat).
gmaps_walk <- function(a, b, via = list()) {
  ll <- function(p) sprintf("%.6f,%.6f", p[2], p[1])
  u <- sprintf("https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=%s&destination=%s&travelmode=walking", ll(a), ll(b))
  if (length(via)) u <- paste0(u, "&waypoints=", paste(vapply(via, ll, character(1)), collapse = "%7C"))
  u
}
gmaps_place <- function(p) sprintf("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%.6f,%.6f", p[2], p[1])

fmt_dist <- function(m) if (m < 950) sprintf(tr("%d m"), as.integer(round(m / 10) * 10)) else sprintf(tr("%.1f km"), m / 1000)

# Map of one plan. ids: node ids in visiting order, from the start point to the end point; key: a
# word unique in the document (the SVG filter needs its own id).
route_map_svg <- function(D, ids, opt, key) {
  W <- EXPORT_MAP$w; H <- EXPORT_MAP$h; pad <- EXPORT_MAP$pad
  pts <- lapply(ids, function(id) node_lonlat(D, id))
  legs <- lapply(seq_len(length(ids) - 1), function(k) {
    if (ids[k] == ids[k + 1]) return(NULL)
    leg_coords(D, ids[k], ids[k + 1]) %||% rbind(pts[[k]], pts[[k + 1]])   # straight if no line is stored
  })
  all <- do.call(rbind, c(Filter(Negate(is.null), legs), list(do.call(rbind, pts))))
  # The zoom (fractional, up to 17) at which everything just fits inside the padding. Tiles come from
  # the next whole zoom and are drawn a little smaller (scale f), so they stay sharp in print.
  p0 <- merc_px(all[, 1], all[, 2], 0)
  zc <- min(17, log2((W - 2 * pad) / max(diff(range(p0[, 1])), 1e-9)), log2((H - 2 * pad) / max(diff(range(p0[, 2])), 1e-9)))
  zt <- ceiling(zc); f <- 2^(zc - zt); ts <- 256 * f
  p <- p0 * 2^zc
  ox <- mean(range(p[, 1])) - W / 2; oy <- mean(range(p[, 2])) - H / 2   # world pixel of the top-left corner
  xy <- function(m) { q <- merc_px(m[, 1], m[, 2], 0) * 2^zc; cbind(q[, 1] - ox, q[, 2] - oy) }
  path <- function(m) { q <- xy(m); paste0("M", paste(sprintf("%.1f %.1f", q[, 1], q[, 2]), collapse = " L")) }
  tiles <- expand.grid(x = floor(ox / ts):floor((ox + W - 1) / ts), y = floor(oy / ts):floor((oy + H - 1) / ts))
  img <- sprintf('<image href="%s" x="%.2f" y="%.2f" width="%.2f" height="%.2f"/>',   # +0.5: no hairline seams
                 sprintf(TILE_URL, zt, tiles$x, tiles$y), tiles$x * ts - ox, tiles$y * ts - oy, ts + 0.5, ts + 0.5)
  lines <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(legs), function(k) {
    if (is.null(legs[[k]])) return(NULL)
    d <- path(legs[[k]]); back <- k == length(legs)
    c(sprintf('<path d="%s" class="casing"/>', d),
      sprintf('<path d="%s" class="walk%s"/>', d, if (back) " back" else ""))
  }))
  s <- xy(do.call(rbind, pts))
  n <- length(opt$order)
  lv <- busy_level(opt$busy, D$busy_cuts)
  stops <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(k) {
    sprintf('<g class="stop"><circle cx="%.1f" cy="%.1f" r="11" fill="%s" stroke="%s"/><text x="%.1f" y="%.1f"%s>%d</text></g>',
            s[k + 1, 1], s[k + 1, 2], busy_col(lv[k]), if (opt$problem[k] > 0) "#D70015" else "#FFFFFF",
            s[k + 1, 1], s[k + 1, 2] + 4, if (!is.na(lv[k]) && lv[k] == 3) ' fill="#FFFFFF"' else "", k)
  }, character(1))
  same_end <- ids[1] == ids[length(ids)]
  label <- function(r, txt, dy) sprintf('<text class="end-label" x="%.1f" y="%.1f">%s</text>', s[r, 1], s[r, 2] + dy, htmltools::htmlEscape(txt))
  ends <- c(sprintf('<circle class="start" cx="%.1f" cy="%.1f" r="7"/>', s[1, 1], s[1, 2]),
            label(1, if (same_end) tr("Start and end") else tr("Start"), 22),
            if (!same_end) c(sprintf('<circle class="end" cx="%.1f" cy="%.1f" r="7"/>', s[nrow(s), 1], s[nrow(s), 2]),
                             label(nrow(s), tr("End"), 22)))
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    sprintf('<svg viewBox="0 0 %d %d" role="img" aria-label="%s">', W, H, htmltools::htmlEscape(tr("Map of the walk"))),
    sprintf('<defs><filter id="mute-%s"><feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0.3"/></filter></defs>', key),
    sprintf('<g filter="url(#mute-%s)">%s</g>', key, paste(img, collapse = "")),
    sprintf('<rect width="%d" height="%d" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".22"/>', W, H),
    paste(lines, collapse = ""), paste(ends, collapse = ""), paste(stops, collapse = ""),
    sprintf('<text class="attrib" x="%d" y="%d">%s</text>', W - 8, H - 8, "© OpenStreetMap contributors"),
    "</svg>"))
}

# Is the plan in time, open everywhere, and does it keep the slack free? list(level, text).
plan_verdict <- function(D, opt, cx, pace) {
  n <- length(opt$order)
  if (opt$n_problems == 0 && opt$late == 0) {
    len <- cx$deadline - cx$t0
    unplanned <- len - sum(cx$stay[opt$order]) * PACES[[pace]]$stay - opt$walk_total
    if (unplanned < slack_for(len))
      return(list(level = "warn", text = sprintf(tr("It fits, but it is tight: only %s of this %s free time is left unplanned."),
                                                 fmt_dur(max(0, unplanned)), fmt_dur(len))))
    return(list(level = "ok", text = sprintf(if (n == 1) tr("It fits: back at %s by %s, %s to spare.")
                                             else tr("All stops fit: back at %s by %s, %s to spare."),
                                             node_name_d(D, cx$end_id), fmt_time(opt$finish), fmt_dur(cx$deadline - opt$finish))))
  }
  why <- c()
  for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    nm <- place_name(D, opt$order[k])
    if (opt$problem[k] == 1) why <- c(why, sprintf(tr("%s is closed on %s"), nm, day_name(cx$day)))
    if (opt$problem[k] == 2) why <- c(why, sprintf(tr("%s closes at %s"), nm, fmt_time(cx$close[opt$order[k]])))
  }
  if (opt$late > 0) why <- c(why, sprintf(tr("you would be back %s late"), fmt_dur(opt$late)))
  list(level = "bad", text = sprintf(tr("This plan does not fit: %s."), paste(why, collapse = if (is_zh()) "\uff1b" else "; ")))
}

node_name_d <- function(D, id) if (id %in% D$places$id) place_name(D, match(id, D$places$id)) else start_name(D, id)

# One free time: its heading, the verdict, the map and the stops.
export_day <- function(D, B, w, opt, cx, walks, pace) {
  P <- D$places
  n <- length(opt$order)
  ids <- c(cx$start_id, P$id[opt$order], cx$end_id)
  ll <- lapply(ids, function(id) node_lonlat(D, id))
  dist <- function(a, b) D$M[match(a, D$nodes), match(b, D$nodes)]
  ef <- outing_effort(D, opt$order, pace, cx$start_id, cx$end_id)
  v <- plan_verdict(D, opt, cx, pace)
  walk_row <- function(k, minutes) {            # the walk into stop k (or back, k = n + 1)
    if (minutes < 0.5) return(NULL)
    htmltools::tags$tr(class = "ex-walk", htmltools::tags$td(), htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::tags$i()),
      htmltools::tags$td(colspan = 2,
        sprintf(tr("Walk %s · %s"), fmt_dur(minutes), fmt_dist(dist(ids[k], ids[k + 1]))), " · ",
        htmltools::a(href = gmaps_walk(ll[[k]], ll[[k + 1]]), target = "_blank", tr("Directions ↗"))))
  }
  part_no <- part_of(opt$start)
  rows <- list()
  if (w$rest > 0) {
    walk <- D$W[match(w$base_start, D$nodes), match(w$start, D$nodes)] * PACES[[pace]]$walk
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$tr(class = "ex-rest",
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "t", fmt_time(w$base_t0)), htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::tags$i("☕")),
      htmltools::tags$td(colspan = 2, htmltools::strong(sprintf(tr("Rest at %s"), node_name_d(D, w$start))),
        htmltools::tags$small(if (walk > 0.5) sprintf(tr("%s · walk %s there from %s"), fmt_dur(w$rest), fmt_dur(walk), node_name_d(D, w$base_start))
                              else fmt_dur(w$rest))))
  }
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$tr(class = "ex-start",
    htmltools::tags$td(class = "t", fmt_time(cx$t0)), htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::tags$i()),
    htmltools::tags$td(colspan = 2, htmltools::strong(sprintf(tr("Leave %s"), node_name_d(D, cx$start_id)))))
  for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    # a heading where the part of the day changes (and above the first stop if its part is a walk)
    wk <- walks[[slot_key(w$id, PARTS$part[part_no[k]])]]
    if ((length(unique(part_no)) > 1 && (k == 1 || part_no[k] != part_no[k - 1])) || (k == 1 && !is.null(wk))) {
      j <- if (!is.null(wk)) match(wk, B$id) else NA
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$tr(class = "ex-part", htmltools::tags$td(colspan = 4,
        tr(PARTS$label[part_no[k]]),
        if (!is.na(j)) htmltools::span(sprintf(if (is.na(B$official_walk[j])) tr("Team-made walk: %s") else tr("City walk: %s"),
                                               bundle_name(B, j)))))
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- walk_row(k, opt$walk_in[k])
    i <- opt$order[k]; p <- P[i, ]
    lv <- busy_level(opt$busy[k], D$busy_cuts)
    wait <- if (opt$start[k] > opt$arrive[k] + 0.5) {
      planned <- !is.null(cx$not_before) && !is.na(cx$not_before[i]) && abs(opt$start[k] - cx$not_before[i]) < 0.5
      sprintf(if (planned) tr("%s free before this part of the day starts") else tr("wait %s for opening"), fmt_dur(opt$start[k] - opt$arrive[k]))
    }
    note <- c(if (opt$problem[k] == 1) tr("closed today"), if (opt$problem[k] == 2) sprintf(tr("closes %s"), fmt_time(cx$close[i])))
    name <- if (!is.na(p$official_url) && nzchar(p$official_url))
      htmltools::a(class = "ex-place", href = p$official_url, target = "_blank", place_name(D, i))
      else htmltools::strong(class = "ex-place", place_name(D, i))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$tr(class = paste("ex-stop", if (opt$problem[k] > 0) "bad"),
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "t", htmltools::strong(fmt_time(opt$start[k])),
                         htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("to %s"), fmt_time(opt$end[k])))),
      htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::tags$i(class = paste0("lv", if (is.na(lv)) 0 else lv), k)),
      htmltools::tags$td(name,
        htmltools::tags$small(paste0(paste(c(tr(p$category), tr(tools::toTitleCase(p$entry)), tr(tools::toTitleCase(p$setting)),
                                             if (!is.na(cx$open[i])) (if (cx$open[i] == 0 && cx$close[i] == 1440) hours_text(0, 1440)
                                                                      else sprintf(tr("open %s"), hours_text(cx$open[i], cx$close[i])))),
                                           collapse = " · "), " · "),
                              htmltools::a(href = gmaps_place(ll[[k + 1]]), target = "_blank", tr("On the map ↗"))),
        if (length(note)) htmltools::tags$small(class = "note", paste(note, collapse = tr(", "))),
        if (!is.null(wait)) htmltools::tags$small(class = "wait", wait)),
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "r", htmltools::strong(fmt_dur(opt$end[k] - opt$start[k])),
                         htmltools::tags$small(if (is.na(lv)) tr("no street count") else tr(BUSY_LABELS[lv]))))
  }
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- walk_row(n + 1, opt$walk_back)
  spare <- cx$deadline - opt$finish
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$tr(class = "ex-back",
    htmltools::tags$td(class = "t", htmltools::strong(fmt_time(opt$finish))),
    htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::tags$i(class = if (spare >= 0) "done" else "late", if (spare >= 0) "✓" else "!")),
    htmltools::tags$td(colspan = 2, htmltools::strong(sprintf(tr("Back at %s"), node_name_d(D, cx$end_id))),
      htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(if (spare >= 0) tr("%s spare before %s") else tr("%s late for %s"), fmt_dur(abs(spare)), fmt_time(cx$deadline)))))
  htmltools::tags$section(class = "ex-day", id = paste0("ex-", w$id),
    htmltools::div(class = "ex-day-head",
      htmltools::div(htmltools::p(class = "ex-eyebrow", fmt_date(w$date, "%A %e %B")),
                     htmltools::h2(sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_time(w$t0), fmt_time(w$t1)))),
      htmltools::div(class = "ex-facts",
        htmltools::span(sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(w$t1 - w$t0))),
        htmltools::span(sprintf(tr("%d place%s"), n, pl(n))),
        htmltools::span(sprintf(tr("%s on the go"), fmt_dur(ef$minutes))),
        effort_tag(ef$steps, what = tr("from your start, the stops and back")))),
    htmltools::p(class = paste("ex-verdict", v$level), v$text),
    htmltools::a(class = "ex-map", href = gmaps_walk(ll[[1]], ll[[length(ll)]], ll[-c(1, length(ll))]), target = "_blank",
                 title = tr("Open the whole walk in Google Maps"), route_map_svg(D, ids, opt, w$id)),
    htmltools::p(class = "ex-map-note",
      tr("Stops are coloured by how busy the street is when you get there (light: quiet, dark: busy); the dashed line is the way back. Click the map for the whole walk in Google Maps.")),
    htmltools::tags$table(class = "ex-stops", htmltools::tags$tbody(rows)))
}

# The whole document. plans: window id -> list(opt, cx) for the free times with something planned;
# scope: "all" or one window id.
export_doc <- function(D, B, ws, plans, walks, scope = "all", pace = "normal") {
  if (scope != "all") ws <- ws[ws$id == scope, ]
  has <- ws$id %in% names(plans)
  dates <- sort(unique(ws$date))
  yr <- format(if (length(dates)) max(dates) else Sys.Date(), "%Y")
  span_txt <- if (length(dates) == 0) "" else if (length(dates) == 1) paste(fmt_date(dates, "%A %e %B"), yr)
              else paste0(fmt_date(min(dates), "%a %e %b"), " – ", fmt_date(max(dates), "%a %e %b"), " ", yr)
  span_txt <- gsub(" +", " ", span_txt)
  sums <- lapply(ws$id[has], function(id) { p <- plans[[id]]; outing_effort(D, p$opt$order, pace, p$cx$start_id, p$cx$end_id) })
  n_places <- sum(vapply(ws$id[has], function(id) length(plans[[id]]$opt$order), integer(1)))
  tot_min <- sum(vapply(sums, function(e) e$minutes, numeric(1))); tot_steps <- sum(vapply(sums, function(e) e$steps, numeric(1)))
  facts <- c(if (scope == "all") sprintf(tr("%d free time%s"), nrow(ws), pl(nrow(ws))),
             sprintf(tr("%d place%s"), n_places, pl(n_places)),
             if (n_places) sprintf(tr("%s on the go"), fmt_dur(tot_min)), if (n_places) fmt_steps(tot_steps))
  glance <- if (scope == "all" && nrow(ws)) htmltools::tags$table(class = "ex-glance",
    htmltools::tags$thead(htmltools::tags$tr(htmltools::tags$th(tr("Day")), htmltools::tags$th(tr("Free")),
      htmltools::tags$th(tr("Places, in order")), htmltools::tags$th(tr("On the go")), htmltools::tags$th(tr("Effort")))),
    htmltools::tags$tbody(lapply(seq_len(nrow(ws)), function(k) {
      id <- ws$id[k]; p <- plans[[id]]
      day <- fmt_date(ws$date[k], "%a %e %b")
      if (is.null(p)) return(htmltools::tags$tr(class = "empty", htmltools::tags$td(day),
        htmltools::tags$td(sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_time(ws$t0[k]), fmt_time(ws$t1[k]))),
        htmltools::tags$td(colspan = 3, tr("Nothing planned"))))
      e <- sums[[match(id, ws$id[has])]]
      v <- plan_verdict(D, p$opt, p$cx, pace)
      htmltools::tags$tr(
        htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::a(href = paste0("#ex-", id), day)),
        htmltools::tags$td(sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_time(ws$t0[k]), fmt_time(ws$t1[k]))),
        htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::span(class = paste("ex-dot", v$level), title = v$text),
                           paste(place_name(D, p$opt$order), collapse = " → ")),
        htmltools::tags$td(fmt_dur(e$minutes)),
        htmltools::tags$td(effort_tag(e$steps, what = tr("from your start, the stops and back"))))
    })))
  stamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d", tz = "Australia/Melbourne")
  # where the numbers come from, and the credits: on the first page for the whole trip (each free
  # time then starts a page of its own), after the plan for a single free time
  about <- htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(class = "ex-notes",
      htmltools::h3(tr("Good to know")),
      htmltools::tags$ul(
        htmltools::tags$li(sprintf(tr("Times are estimates: the usual time at each place, and walking along the streets (Vicmap road network) at a %s pace. Each part of a day keeps at least a quarter of its time free for queues, breaks and surprises."),
                                   tolower(tr(PACES[[pace]]$label)))),
        htmltools::tags$li(tr("Opening hours are from each place's official website, checked in October 2026. Check again before you go: the place names link to the websites.")),
        htmltools::tags$li(tr("Street busyness is the average number of people per hour near the place at that time, from the City of Melbourne's pedestrian sensors (October 2025 to October 2026).")),
        htmltools::tags$li(tr("Each map opens the whole walk in Google Maps; “Directions” opens one leg, “On the map” the place.")))),
    htmltools::tags$footer(class = "ex-foot",
      sprintf(tr("Made with Melbourne in N Hours on %s (GEOM90007 Group 24)."), stamp), " ",
      tr("Data: City of Melbourne Open Data (pedestrian counts, landmarks, Self Guided Walks); Vicmap Transport (DataVic) for the walking network; opening hours from each place's official website. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors.")))
  htmltools::div(class = paste("ex-paper", if (scope == "all") "ex-trip"),
    `data-filename` = paste("Melbourne in N Hours - plan", gsub("\u2013", "-", span_txt)),
    htmltools::tags$header(class = "ex-cover",
      htmltools::div(class = "ex-brand", htmltools::span("N"), "Melbourne in N Hours"),
      htmltools::h1(if (scope == "all") tr("Your Melbourne plan") else tr("Your plan for this free time")),
      htmltools::p(class = "ex-sub", span_txt, htmltools::HTML(" · "), paste(facts, collapse = " · ")),
      glance,
      if (scope == "all" && any(has)) htmltools::p(class = "ex-dots",
        htmltools::span(htmltools::span(class = "ex-dot ok"), tr("fits")),
        htmltools::span(htmltools::span(class = "ex-dot warn"), tr("fits, but tight")),
        htmltools::span(htmltools::span(class = "ex-dot bad"), tr("does not fit"))),
      if (!any(has)) htmltools::p(class = "ex-empty", tr("Nothing is planned yet. Add places to your free times, then export again.")),
      if (scope == "all") about),
    lapply(which(has), function(k) export_day(D, B, ws[k, ], plans[[ws$id[k]]]$opt, plans[[ws$id[k]]]$cx, walks, pace)),
    if (scope != "all") htmltools::div(class = "ex-after", about))
}

name: R/i18n.R
content:
# Two languages for the interface: English (the default) and Chinese, switched in Trip settings
# (input$lang). The code itself stays in English; the Chinese lives in data/i18n/:
#   zh_names.csv  places, stations, walks and official walk names (kind, key, zh)
#   zh_ui*.csv    every interface text, keyed by its English text (en, zh). For a sentence with
#                 numbers or names the key is the sprintf template itself, so the Chinese template
#                 must have the same placeholders (use %1$s, %2$s to put them in another order).
# tools/check_i18n.py checks that every literal passed to tr() has a Chinese entry with the same
# placeholders.
#
# tr() finds the language from the session it runs in (shiny's reactive domain) and reads
# input$lang there, so every output or observer that uses it is redrawn when the language changes.
# Outside a session (start-up code) it gives the English text. Static parts of the page (built once)
# use i18n(), which www/app.js swaps on the page.

load_i18n <- function(dir = "data/i18n") {
  files <- list.files(dir, "^zh_ui.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  ui <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(f) read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")))
  ui <- ui[!duplicated(ui$en), ]
  nm <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "zh_names.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  list(ui = setNames(ui$zh, ui$en), names = setNames(nm$zh, paste(nm$kind, nm$key, sep = "|")))
}
I18N <- load_i18n()

cur_lang <- function() {
  dom <- shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
  if (is.null(dom)) return("en")
  l <- tryCatch(dom$input$lang, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (identical(l, "zh")) "zh" else "en"
}
is_zh <- function() cur_lang() == "zh"

# English text (or sprintf template) -> the current language; vectorised.
tr <- function(s) {
  if (!is_zh()) return(s)
  z <- unname(I18N$ui[s])
  ifelse(is.na(z), s, z)
}
# Plural "s" of English words ("3 place%s"); nothing in Chinese.
pl <- function(n) if (!is_zh() && n != 1) "s" else ""

# Names from the data in the current language.
zh_name <- function(kind, key, en) {
  if (!is_zh()) return(en)
  z <- unname(I18N$names[paste(kind, key, sep = "|")])
  ifelse(is.na(z), en, z)
}
place_name <- function(D, i) zh_name("place", D$places$id[i], D$places$name[i])
start_name <- function(D, id) zh_name("start", id, D$starts$name[match(id, D$starts$id)])
bundle_name <- function(B, k) zh_name("bundle_name", B$id[k], B$name[k])
bundle_idea <- function(B, k) zh_name("bundle_idea", B$id[k], B$idea[k])
official_walk_name <- function(x) zh_name("official_walk", x, x)

# Weekday i (1 = Monday): "Monday" (full), "Mon" (short) or "Mondays" (plural), in the current language.
day_name <- function(i, form = "full") {
  en <- DAY_LABELS[i]
  tr(switch(form, full = en, short = substr(en, 1, 3), plural = paste0(en, "s")))
}
# Dates in the few formats the interface uses: "%a %e %b" (Wed 4 Nov), "%A %e %B" (Wednesday 4
# November), "%e %b" (4 Nov), "%a" and "%A".
fmt_date <- function(d, f = "%a %e %b") {
  if (!is_zh()) return(trimws(format(d, f)))
  wd <- as.integer(format(d, "%u"))
  md <- sprintf(tr("DATE %d/%d"), as.integer(format(d, "%m")), as.integer(format(d, "%d")))
  switch(f,
    "%a %e %b" = paste(md, day_name(wd, "short")),
    "%A %e %B" = paste(md, day_name(wd, "full")),
    "%e %b" = md,
    "%a" = day_name(wd, "short"),
    "%A" = day_name(wd, "full"),
    trimws(format(d, f)))
}

# A piece of the static page (built once) in the current language: English in the page, swapped by
# www/app.js when the language changes. `key` tells apart the same English word used for different
# things (e.g. "From" a time and "From" a place).
i18n <- function(s, key = s) htmltools::span(`data-i18n` = key, `data-en` = s, s)

name: R/overview.R
content:
# Home page, three columns: the ready-made walks on the left, the days in the middle (one row per day
# of the trip, split into morning, afternoon and evening), every single place on the right. A walk or a
# place is dragged from either side into a part of a day (or + picks one, R/slots.R). Only places are
# decided here; the order and the route come on each day's page.
# While something is dragged, the parts it fits turn green (amber if it would leave little time free)
# and the parts where it is closed or too long fade (www/app.js).
#
# Each day row has a thin time strip on the same 8-22 h axis as its three columns (4:5:5, as long as
# the parts): the free time as a white bar whose two ends can be dragged to change it (www/app.js), the
# city's street busyness by hour underneath (orange), sunset (dashed line) and where the parts meet
# (12:00 and 17:00, fixed: a day's routine).

hours_text <- function(o, cl) {
  if (is.na(o)) return(tr("Closed"))
  if (o == 0 && cl == 1440) return(tr("Open all day"))
  sprintf("%s–%s", sub(":00$", "", fmt_time(o)), sub(":00$", "", fmt_time(cl)))
}

DAY_LO <- 8 * 60
DAY_HI <- 22 * 60
pct <- function(t) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * (min(max(t, DAY_LO), DAY_HI) - DAY_LO) / (DAY_HI - DAY_LO))
pct_w <- function(a, b) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * max(0, min(b, DAY_HI) - max(a, DAY_LO)) / (DAY_HI - DAY_LO))

# Opening hours of place i on each day of the trip, for its tooltip.
trip_hours <- function(D, i, dates) {
  paste(vapply(dates, function(d) {
    wd <- as.integer(format(d, "%u"))
    sprintf("%s %s", fmt_date(d, "%a"), hours_text(D$open[i, wd], D$close[i, wd]))
  }, character(1)), collapse = " · ")
}

drag_attrs <- function(item, fit, from = NULL) {
  list(draggable = "true", `data-item` = item, `data-fit` = as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(fit), auto_unbox = TRUE)),
       `data-from` = from)
}

# One place in a slot: name, about how long, how tiring; drag it to another part, × takes it out.
slot_chip <- function(D, i, key, fit, pace) {
  p <- D$places[i, ]
  do.call(htmltools::div, c(list(class = "slot-chip", title = tr("Drag to another part of a day, or × to take it out")),
    drag_attrs(paste0("place:", p$id), fit, key),
    list(htmltools::strong(place_name(D, i)),
         htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("~%s"), fmt_dur(p$stay_min * PACES[[pace]]$stay))),
         effort_tag(inside_m(D, i, pace) / 1000 * STEPS_PER_KM, "place", steps_text = FALSE),
         htmltools::tags$button(class = "chip-x", title = tr("Take it out"), onclick = js_input("slot_remove", p$id), "×"))))
}

# `use`: this free time's minutes per part from its day plan (part_minutes(), R/slots.R), so a part says
# "tight" exactly when the day page would; without a plan, the quick estimate of fit_check().
slot_box <- function(D, B, part, slots, walks, sugg, fits, pace, use = NULL) {
  key <- part$key
  ids <- slots[[key]] %||% character()
  idx <- match(ids, D$places$id)
  w <- walks[[key]]
  shown <- part                                  # a walk with a start time (the sunset one) uses the part from then
  if (!is.null(w)) part <- bundle_part(B, match(w, B$id), part)
  len <- part$t1 - part$t0
  chk <- fit_check(D, idx, part, pace)
  um <- if (!is.null(use) && key %in% names(use$minutes)) use$minutes[[key]] else NA_real_
  if (!is.na(um)) len <- use$len[[key]]          # the part's share of the free time, by the clock
  used <- if (!is.na(um)) um else if (length(idx) && !is.na(chk$minutes)) chk$minutes else if (length(idx)) bundle_walk(D, idx, pace)$minutes else 0
  free <- len - used
  closed <- length(idx) > 0 && chk$status == "no" && is.na(chk$minutes)     # closed, or not open long enough
  # with a day plan, its own problems decide (a visit may run on into the next part and still work)
  state <- if (!length(idx) && used == 0) "empty"
           else if (free < 0 || (if (is.na(um)) closed else use$bad[[key]])) "over"
           else if (free < slack_for(len) && (is.na(um) || use$tight)) "tight" else "ok"
  sg <- sugg[[key]]
  htmltools::div(class = paste("slot", state), `data-slot` = key,
    htmltools::div(class = "slot-head",
      htmltools::strong(tr(part$label)),
      htmltools::span(sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_time(shown$t0), fmt_time(shown$t1)))),
    htmltools::div(class = "slot-meter", title = sprintf(tr("Planned about %s of %s; we keep at least %s free"),
                                                        fmt_dur(used), fmt_dur(len), fmt_dur(slack_for(len))),
      htmltools::tags$i(htmltools::tags$b(style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%", min(100, 100 * used / len))),
                        htmltools::tags$u(style = sprintf("left:%.1f%%", 100 * (len - slack_for(len)) / len))),
      htmltools::tags$small(if (state == "empty") sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(len))
                            else if (state == "over") (if (closed) chk$why else if (free < 0) sprintf(tr("Over by %s"), fmt_dur(-free))
                                                      else tr("A place here closes before the visit ends: open the day to see"))
                            else if (state == "tight") sprintf(tr("Tight: %s free"), fmt_dur(free))
                            else sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(free)))),
    if (!is.null(w)) { k <- match(w, B$id)
      htmltools::div(class = "slot-walk",
        htmltools::span(if (is.na(B$official_walk[k])) tr("Team-made walk") else sprintf(tr("City walk: %s"), official_walk_name(B$official_walk[k]))),
        htmltools::strong(bundle_name(B, k)),
        htmltools::tags$button(class = "chip-x", title = tr("Clear this part"), onclick = js_input("slot_clear", key), "×"),
        if (part$t0 > shown$t0) htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("Starts around %s"), fmt_time(part$t0)))) },
    if (length(idx)) htmltools::div(class = "slot-items",
      lapply(idx, function(i) slot_chip(D, i, key, fits$place[[D$places$id[i]]], pace)),
      effort_tag(outing_effort(D, bundle_walk(D, idx, pace)$order, pace)$steps))
    else if (!is.null(sg)) {
      bw <- bundle_walk(D, B$core[[sg]], pace); ef <- outing_effort(D, bw$order, pace)
      htmltools::div(class = "slot-suggest", title = bundle_reason(D, B, sg, part),
        htmltools::tags$small(if (is.na(B$official_walk[sg])) tr("Suggested · team-made walk") else tr("Suggested · City walk")),
        htmltools::strong(bundle_name(B, sg)),
        htmltools::span(paste(place_name(D, bw$order), collapse = " → ")),
        htmltools::div(class = "slot-suggest-foot",   # "About %1$s": a duration (see place_card)
          htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("About %1$s"), fmt_dur(ef$minutes))), effort_tag(ef$steps, steps_text = FALSE),
          htmltools::tags$button(class = "btn primary", onclick = js_input("take_suggestion", key), tr("Take"))))
    }
    else htmltools::p(class = "slot-hint", tr("Drop a walk or a place here")))
}

day_row <- function(D, B, d, ws, parts, slots, walks, sugg, fits, sums, busy, pace) {
  k <- which(ws$date == d)
  wd <- as.integer(format(d, "%u"))
  sm <- Filter(Negate(is.null), sums[ws$id[k]])
  sun <- sunset_min(d)
  any_ids <- unlist(lapply(ws$id[k], function(id) slots[[slot_key(id, SLOT_ANY)]]), use.names = FALSE)
  # one white bar per free time, with a dot at each end to drag it longer or shorter (in quarter
  # hours, at least 30 minutes long, not into the free time before or after it that day)
  ends <- function(j) {
    prev <- max(c(DAY_LO, ws$t1[k][ws$t1[k] <= ws$t0[j]]))
    nxt <- min(c(DAY_HI, ws$t0[k][ws$t0[k] >= ws$t1[j]]))
    lapply(c("t0", "t1"), function(f) {
      t <- ws[[f]][j]
      lim <- if (f == "t0") c(prev, ws$t1[j] - 30) else c(ws$t0[j] + 30, nxt)
      htmltools::tags$button(class = paste("free-handle", f), `data-wid` = ws$id[j], `data-field` = f, `data-t` = t,
        `data-min` = lim[1], `data-max` = lim[2], style = sprintf("left:%s", pct(t)),
        title = sprintf(if (f == "t0") tr("Drag to change when this free time starts (now %s)")
                        else tr("Drag to change when this free time ends (now %s)"), fmt_time(t)),
        `aria-label` = sprintf(if (f == "t0") tr("Free time starts on %s: %s") else tr("Free time ends on %s: %s"),
                               fmt_date(d, "%A"), fmt_time(t)),
        htmltools::tags$em(fmt_time(t)))
    })
  }
  strip <- htmltools::div(class = "day-strip",
    lapply(c(PARTS$to[1:2]), function(t) htmltools::tags$i(class = "strip-split", style = sprintf("left:%s", pct(t)))),
    lapply(k, function(j) htmltools::tags$i(class = "strip-free", `data-wid` = ws$id[j],
      style = sprintf("left:%s; width:%s", pct(ws$t0[j]), pct_w(ws$t0[j], ws$t1[j])),
      title = sprintf(tr("Free %s–%s"), fmt_time(ws$t0[j]), fmt_time(ws$t1[j])))),
    htmltools::div(class = "strip-band", lapply(seq(DAY_LO, DAY_HI - 60, by = 60), function(h)
      htmltools::tags$i(class = paste0("lv", busy$level[wd, h / 60 + 1]), style = sprintf("left:%s; width:%s", pct(h), pct_w(h, h + 60)),
                        title = sprintf(tr("%s %02d:00 · about %s people/h on the streets near our places"), day_name(wd), h / 60,
                                        format(round(busy$count[wd, h / 60 + 1], -1), big.mark = ","))))),
    if (sun > DAY_LO && sun < DAY_HI) htmltools::tags$i(class = "strip-sun", style = sprintf("left:%s", pct(sun)),
                                                         title = sprintf(tr("Sunset about %s"), fmt_time(sun))),
    lapply(k, ends))
  cols <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(PARTS)), function(j) {
    here <- parts[parts$window %in% ws$id[k] & parts$part == PARTS$part[j], ]
    htmltools::div(class = "day-col",
      if (nrow(here)) lapply(seq_len(nrow(here)), function(r) slot_box(D, B, here[r, ], slots, walks, sugg, fits, pace,
                                                                          sums[[here$window[r]]]$parts))
      else htmltools::div(class = "slot none", htmltools::span(tr(PARTS$label[j])), htmltools::tags$small(tr("Not free"))))
  })
  # A day folds to its first line (www/app.js toggleFold); folded, it also names what is planned.
  planned <- unique(unlist(slots[vapply(names(slots), function(nm) slot_window(nm) %in% ws$id[k], logical(1))], use.names = FALSE))
  htmltools::div(class = "day-row foldable", `data-fold` = paste0("plan|", format(d)),
    htmltools::div(class = "day-label",
      fold_button(),
      htmltools::strong(fmt_date(d, "%a %e %b")),
      htmltools::tags$small(class = "fold-sum",
        if (length(planned)) paste(place_name(D, match(planned, D$places$id)), collapse = " · ") else tr("Nothing planned yet")),
      htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(sum(ws$t1[k] - ws$t0[k])))),
      if (length(sm)) htmltools::tagList(
        htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("%s on the go"), fmt_dur(sum(vapply(sm, function(x) x$minutes, numeric(1)))))),
        effort_tag(sum(vapply(sm, function(x) x$steps, numeric(1))), what = tr("from your start, the stops and back"))),
      lapply(k, function(j) htmltools::div(class = "day-buttons",
        htmltools::tags$button(class = "day-open", onclick = js_input("goto", ws$id[j]),
          title = tr("Open this free time: order, times and route"),
